1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
3import Generated.Copy
4
5namespace Specs.Copy
6
7open Gellar.Kernel Generated.Copy
8
9/-- Copies the first `n` cells of `src` to `out`. -/
10contract copy (out : int*) (src : int*) (n : int) where
11 requires n ≤ gridDim * blockDim
12 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
13 ensures out[i] = src[i] when 0 ≤ i < n
14 ensures out[i] = old(out[i]) otherwise
15 unchanged src
16
17private theorem copy_log (gd bd : Nat) (args : Env) (mem : Mem) (sh : Nat → Mem) (fl : FStore) (b t : Nat) :
18 copy.log gd bd (launchIds gd bd) args mem sh fl b t =
19 if ((gid bd b t : Nat) : Int) < args "n" then
20 [.read "src" (gid bd b t), .write "out" (gid bd b t) (mem "src" (gid bd b t))]
21 else [] := by
22 log_cases copy
23
24theorem copy_contract : copy.contract := by
25 contract_intro ⟨hn, hgb, -⟩
26 have h : Pointwise copy gd bd (launchIds gd bd) args mem sh fl "out" (fun g => (g : Int) < args "n")
27 (fun g => g) (fun g => mem "src" g) := by
28 pointwise_of copy copy_log
29 contract_clauses h
30 intro i h0 hi
31 obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le h0
32 rw [h.run_active (by omega) hi, h.run_other (a' := "src") (by decide)]
33
34end Specs.Copy

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Pointwise
3import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
4import Generated.Gridstride
5
6namespace Specs.Gridstride
7
8open Gellar.Kernel Generated.Gridstride
9
10/-- Writes `2 * i` into every cell `i` below `n`, however few threads are launched: each
11thread strides through the array. The stride, the last index a thread steps to past `n`, and
12`2 * i` are computed in `int`. -/
13contract gridstride (out : int*) (n : int) where
14 requires 0 < gridDim * blockDim
15 requires gridDim * blockDim < 2^31
16 requires n + gridDim * blockDim < 2^31
17 requires 2 * n ≤ 2^31
18 ensures out[i] = 2 * i when 0 ≤ i < n
19 ensures out[i] = old(out[i]) otherwise
20
21/-! ## Proof -/
22
23variable (gd bd : Nat) (args : Env) (mem : Mem) (sh : Nat → Mem) (fl : FStore) (b t : Nat)
24
25/-- The stride. -/
26private abbrev S : Int := (gd : Int) * bd
27
28/-- How many cells `g, g + S, g + 2S, …` lie below `n`. -/
29private abbrev cnt (n S g : Int) : Nat := ((n - g + S - 1) / S).toNat
30
31private theorem lt_cnt (n : Int) {S : Int} (g : Int) (hS : 0 < S) (k : Nat) :
32 k < cnt n S g ↔ g + k * S < n := by
33 rw [cnt, Int.lt_toNat, Int.lt_iff_add_one_le, Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hS, Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul]
34 omega
35
36private theorem cnt_le (n : Int) {S : Int} (g : Int) (hS : 0 < S) : cnt n S g ≤ (n - g).toNat := by
37 rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (cnt n S g) with h | h
38 · omega
39 · have h1 := (lt_cnt n g hS (cnt n S g - 1)).1 (by omega)
40 have hk : ((cnt n S g - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (cnt n S g : Int) - 1 := by omega
41 rw [hk] at h1
42 have : ((cnt n S g : Int) - 1) * 1 ≤ ((cnt n S g : Int) - 1) * S :=
43 Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS (by omega)
44 omega
45
46/-- The writes of thread `g`: its cells `g + k·S` below `n`. -/
47private abbrev writes (g : Nat) : List Access :=
48 (List.range (cnt (args "n") (S gd bd) g)).map fun (k : Nat) =>
49 Access.write "out" (g + k * S gd bd) (2 * (g + k * S gd bd))
50
51/-- The same as cells and values. -/
52private abbrev W (g : Nat) : List (Int × Int) :=
53 (List.range (cnt (args "n") (S gd bd) g)).map fun (k : Nat) =>
54 (g + k * S gd bd, 2 * (g + k * S gd bd))
55
56/-- One turn of the loop, as generated. -/
57private abbrev turn (ids : Ids) : TState → TState :=
58 fun st => (Stm.seq (.store "out" (.var "i") (.bin .mul (.lit 2) (.var "i")))
59 (.assign "i" (.bin .add (.var "i") (.var "stride")))).exec ids
60 (st.reads ids (.bin .lt (.var "i") (.var "n")))
61
62/-- The turns below `n`. -/
63private theorem fit_cnt (g : Nat) (hS : 0 < S gd bd) :
64 ∀ k' < cnt (args "n") (S gd bd) g, (g : Int) + k' * S gd bd < args "n" :=
65 fun k' hk' => (lt_cnt (args "n") g hS k').1 hk'
66
67/-- After `k` turns, each started below `n`: `i` has advanced `k` strides, the log holds the
68`k` writes, and no `int` operation overflowed (`2 * i` stays below `2 * n`, and `i + stride`
69below `n + stride`). -/
70private theorem gridstride_iter (ids : Ids) (k : Nat) (g : Nat) (st : TState)
71 (hi : st.env "i" = g) (hs : st.env "stride" = S gd bd) (hn : st.env "n" = args "n")
72 (hS : 0 < S gd bd) (h2n : 2 * args "n" ≤ 2 ^ 31) (hnS : args "n" + S gd bd < 2 ^ 31)
73 (hfit : ∀ k' < k, (g : Int) + k' * S gd bd < args "n") :
74 (iter (turn ids) k st).env = (fun v => if v = "i" then g + k * S gd bd else st.env v) ∧
75 (iter (turn ids) k st).log = st.log ++ ((List.range k).map fun (k' : Nat) =>
76 Access.write "out" (g + k' * S gd bd) (2 * (g + k' * S gd bd))) ∧
77 (iter (turn ids) k st).ok = st.ok := by
78 induction k generalizing st with
79 | zero =>
80 simp only [iter, List.range_zero, List.map_nil, List.append_nil, and_true]
81 funext v
82 by_cases hv : v = "i" <;> simp [hv, hi]
83 | succ k ih =>
84 rw [iter_succ_apply]
85 obtain ⟨henv, hlog, hok⟩ := ih st hi hs hn (fun k' hk' => hfit k' (by omega))
86 have h1 := hfit k (by omega)
87 have h2 : (0 : Int) ≤ k * S gd bd := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (Int.le_of_lt hS)
88 have hw : int32b (2 * ((g : Int) + k * S gd bd)) = true :=
89 (int32b_eq_true _).2 (by unfold int32; omega)
90 have hadv : int32b ((g : Int) + k * S gd bd + S gd bd) = true :=
91 (int32b_eq_true _).2 (by unfold int32; omega)
92 simp only [turn, Stm.exec_seq, Stm.exec_store, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval,
93 Exp.reads, BinOp.eval, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits, BinOp.evalsRight, List.map, List.append_nil,
94 henv, hlog, hok, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, hs, hn, hw, hadv, Bool.and_true, Bool.true_and,
95 Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or]
96 refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
97 · funext v
98 by_cases hv : v = "i" <;> simp [hv, Int.natCast_add, Int.add_mul, Int.add_assoc]
99 · simp [List.range_succ, List.append_assoc]
100 · trivial
101
102/-- The loop, run from its initial state in thread `g`. -/
103private theorem gridstride_loop (ids : Ids) (g : Nat) (st : TState) (hS : 0 < S gd bd)
104 (hi : st.env "i" = g) (hs : st.env "stride" = S gd bd) (hn : st.env "n" = args "n")

A three-point stencil per block through shared memory, on the interior cells of each block.
CUDA · kernels/stencil.cu · 8 lines
1__global__ void stencil(int* out, int* src) {
2 __shared__ int s[256];
3 int tid = threadIdx.x;
4 int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + tid;
5 s[tid] = src[i];
6 __syncthreads();
7 if (tid > 0 && tid < blockDim.x - 1) out[i] = s[tid - 1] + s[tid] + s[tid + 1];
8}
Contract · 9 lines
stencil(int* out, int* src) 1-D launch✓ proved
RequiresblockDim ≤ 256
RequiresgridDim · blockDim ≤ 231
Requires−231 ≤ src[i − 1] + src[i] < 231for 1 ≤ i < gridDim · blockDim − 1
Requires−231 ≤ src[i − 1] + src[i] + src[i + 1] < 231for 1 ≤ i < gridDim · blockDim − 1
Ensures∀ t, 0 < t ⇒ t + 1 < blockDim ⇒
No data race (two threads touch a cell only if both read it or both add to it atomically); barriers are uniform; every loop terminates; no int operation overflows or divides by zero; every shared-memory access is in bounds. Every int parameter and cell is assumed to hold a 32-bit value, as its type says.

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract

10/-- A three-point stencil, one block at a time through shared memory: every interior cell of a
11block becomes the sum of itself and its two neighbours; the two edge cells of each block are
12left alone. The sum is formed left to right in `int`, so both partial sums must fit. -/
13contract stencil (out : int*) (src : int*) where
14 requires blockDim ≤ 256
15 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
16 requires int32 (src[i - 1] + src[i]) when 1 ≤ i < gridDim * blockDim - 1
17 requires int32 (src[i - 1] + src[i] + src[i + 1]) when 1 ≤ i < gridDim * blockDim - 1
18 ensures ∀ t, 0 < t → t + 1 < blockDim →
19 out[b * blockDim + t] = src[b * blockDim + t - 1] + src[b * blockDim + t] + src[b * blockDim + t + 1]
20 when 0 ≤ b < gridDim
21 ensures ∀ (i : Int), (i < 0 ∨ gridDim * blockDim ≤ i ∨ i % blockDim = 0 ∨ i % blockDim = blockDim - 1) →
22 out[i] = old(out[i])
23 unchanged src
24

27/-- Phase 1, thread `t`: stage `src[g]` in `s[t]`. -/
28private abbrev P1 (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
29 [.read "src" (gid bd b t), .write "s" t (M0 "src" (gid bd b t))]
30
31/-- Memory after the barrier. -/
32private abbrev M1 (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) : Mem :=
33 applyLog M0 ((List.range bd).flatMap (P1 bd M0 b))
34
35/-- What interior thread `t` writes. -/
36private abbrev val (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) (t : Nat) : Int :=
37 M1 bd M0 b "s" ((t : Int) - 1) + M1 bd M0 b "s" t + M1 bd M0 b "s" ((t : Int) + 1)
38
39/-- Phase 2, thread `t`: an interior thread sums its neighbours into `out[g]`. -/
40private abbrev P2 (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
41 if 0 < (t : Int) ∧ (t : Int) < (bd : Int) - 1 then
42 [.read "s" ((t : Int) - 1), .read "s" t, .read "s" ((t : Int) + 1),
43 .write "out" (gid bd b t) (val bd M0 b t)]
44 else []

56 acc = .write "out" (gid bd b t) (val bd M0 b t)) := by

87/-- The two sums an interior thread forms fit, by the precondition on `src`. -/
88private theorem sums_fit (hb : b < gd) (t : Nat) (ht : t < bd)

90 int32 (M0 "src" (i - 1) + M0 "src" i) ∧ int32 (M0 "src" (i - 1) + M0 "src" i + M0 "src" (i + 1)))

1__global__ void matvec(int* y, int* A, int* x, int n, int m) {
2 int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
3 if (i < n) {
4 int s = 0;
5 for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) s += A[i * m + j] * x[j];
6 y[i] = s;
7 }
8}

10/-- `y ← A·x` for an `n × m` matrix `A` stored row-major; one thread per row. The row's dot
11product is accumulated left to right in `int`: every product and every partial sum must fit. -/
12contract matvec (y : int*) (A : int*) (x : int*) (n : int) (m : int) where
13 requires n ≤ gridDim * blockDim
14 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
15 requires n * m ≤ 2^31
16 requires int32 (A[i * m + j] * x[j]) when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ j < m
17 requires int32 (sum j < K, A[i * m + j] * x[j]) when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ K < m + 1
18 ensures y[i] = sum j < m, A[i * m + j] * x[j] when 0 ≤ i < n
19 ensures y[i] = old(y[i]) otherwise
20 unchanged A
21 unchanged x

Each block sums its cells by a shared-memory tree reduction: $\mathit{out}_b = \sum_{j<\mathit{blockDim}} \mathit{src}_{b\cdot\mathit{blockDim}+j}$.
CUDA · kernels/block_sum.cu · 11 lines
1__global__ void block_sum(int* out, int* src) {
2 __shared__ int s[256];
3 int tid = threadIdx.x;
4 s[tid] = src[blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + tid];
5 __syncthreads();
6 for (int d = blockDim.x / 2; d > 0; d /= 2) {
7 if (tid < d) s[tid] += s[tid + d];
8 __syncthreads();
9 }
10 if (tid == 0) out[blockIdx.x] = s[0];
11}

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Phases
3import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
4import Generated.BlockSum

6namespace Specs.BlockSum
7
8open Gellar.Kernel Generated.BlockSum

10/-- Tree reduction in shared memory: each block sums its `blockDim` cells of `src` into
11`out[blockIdx]`, halving the number of active threads at every barrier. Every partial sum is
12a sum of at most 256 cells, so cells of at most 24 bits keep the sums in `int`. -/
13contract block_sum (out : int*) (src : int*) where
14 requires blockDim ≤ 256
15 requires ∃ p : Nat, blockDim = 2 ^ p
16 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
17 requires -2^23 ≤ src[i] ∧ src[i] < 2^23 when 0 ≤ i < gridDim * blockDim
18 ensures out[b] = sum j < blockDim, src[b * blockDim + j] when 0 ≤ b < gridDim
19 ensures ∀ (i : Int), (i < 0 ∨ gridDim ≤ i) → out[i] = old(out[i])
20 unchanged src
21
22/-! ## Proof
23
24The loop runs `p` turns. After `k` turns the active stride is `dk bd k = bd / 2^(k+1)` and the
25first `wk bd k = bd / 2^k` cells of `s` hold partial sums of `2^k` cells each (`S`). -/
26
27/-- The stride after `k` turns. -/
28private def dk (bd k : Nat) : Nat := bd / 2 ^ (k + 1)
29
30/-- The width of the region of `s` holding partial sums after `k` turns. -/
31private def wk (bd k : Nat) : Nat := bd / 2 ^ k
32
33/-- The partial sum in `s[t]` after `k` turns: `2^k` cells of the block, `wk bd k` apart. -/
34private def S (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) (t : Int) : Int :=
35 isum 0 (2 ^ k : Nat) fun m => M0 "src" (((gid bd b 0 : Nat) : Int) + t + m * ((wk bd k : Nat) : Int))
36
37/-- Phase 0, thread `t`: stage `src[g]` in `s[t]`. -/
38private abbrev P0 (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
39 [.read "src" (gid bd b t), .write "s" t (M0 "src" (gid bd b t))]
40
41/-- The phase of turn `k + 1`, thread `t`: the active threads fold the upper half in. -/
42private abbrev Q (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
43 if (t : Int) < ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int) then
44 [.read "s" t, .read "s" ((t : Int) + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)),
45 .write "s" t (S bd M0 b k t + S bd M0 b k ((t : Int) + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)))]
46 else []
47
48/-- The last phase, thread `t`: thread 0 writes the block's sum. -/
49private abbrev Pf (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b p : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
50 if (t : Int) = 0 then [.read "s" 0, .write "out" b (S bd M0 b p 0)] else []
51
52/-- The locals after `k` turns. -/
53private abbrev envk (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (k t : Nat) : Env := fun y =>
54 if y = "d" then ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int) else if y = "tid" then (t : Int) else args y
55
56/-- One turn of the loop, as the lockstep semantics runs it. -/
57private abbrev F (bd : Nat) (ids : Nat → Ids) : Block → Block := fun x =>
58 Block.each ids (Stm.assign "d" (.bin .div (.var "d") (.lit 2)))
59 (Block.commit bd
60 (Block.each ids
61 (Stm.ite (.bin .lt (.var "tid") (.var "d"))
62 (Stm.store "s" (.var "tid")
63 (.bin .add (.load "s" (.var "tid")) (.load "s" (.bin .add (.var "tid") (.var "d")))))
64 Stm.skip)
65 (x.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.lit 0) (.var "d")))))
66
67/-- The loop invariant after `k` turns. -/
68private structure Inv (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) (B : Block) : Prop where
69 ok : B.ok = true
70 env : ∀ t, (B.ts t).env = envk bd args k t
71 log : ∀ t, (B.ts t).log = []
72 tok : ∀ t < bd, (B.ts t).ok = true
73 tmem : ∀ t, (B.ts t).mem = B.mem
74 s : ∀ t : Int, 0 ≤ t → t < wk bd k → B.mem "s" t = S bd M0 b k t
75 other : ∀ a, a ≠ "s" → ∀ i, B.mem a i = M0 a i
76 phases : B.phases = P0 bd M0 b :: (List.range k).map (Q bd M0 b)
77
78/-! ### Arithmetic of the strides -/
79
80private theorem dk_succ (bd k : Nat) : dk bd k / 2 = dk bd (k + 1) := by
81 simp only [dk, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, Nat.pow_succ]
82
83private theorem wk_succ (bd k : Nat) : wk bd (k + 1) = dk bd k := rfl
84
85private theorem wk_eq {bd p k : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) (hk : k < p) : wk bd k = 2 * dk bd k := by
86 subst hbd
87 simp only [wk, dk, Nat.pow_div (Nat.le_of_lt hk) (by omega : 0 < 2),
88 Nat.pow_div hk (by omega : 0 < 2), Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
89 rw [show p - k = (p - (k + 1)) + 1 by omega, Nat.pow_succ]
90 omega
91
92private theorem dk_pos {bd p k : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) (hk : k < p) : 0 < dk bd k := by
93 subst hbd
94 exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)) (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
95
96private theorem dk_last {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) : dk bd p = 0 := by
97 subst hbd
98 exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
99
100private theorem dk_le {bd : Nat} (k : Nat) : 2 * dk bd k ≤ bd := by
101 simp only [dk, Nat.pow_succ]
102 have := Nat.div_mul_le_self bd (2 ^ k * 2)
103 have : 2 ^ k * 2 ≥ 2 := by have := Nat.two_pow_pos k; omega
104 have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (bd / (2 ^ k * 2)) this
105 omega
106
107private theorem wk_le {bd : Nat} (k : Nat) : wk bd k ≤ bd := Nat.div_le_self _ _
108
109private theorem wk_zero (bd : Nat) : wk bd 0 = bd := by simp [wk]
110
111private theorem wk_last {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) : wk bd p = 1 := by
112 subst hbd; simp [wk, Nat.div_self (Nat.two_pow_pos p)]
113
114private theorem p_le_half {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) : p ≤ bd / 2 := by
115 subst hbd
116 cases p with
117 | zero => simp
118 | succ p =>
119 rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (by omega)]
120 have := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := p)
121 omega
122
123/-! ### The partial sums -/
124
125private theorem S_zero (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) (t : Nat) :
126 S bd M0 b 0 t = M0 "src" (gid bd b t) := by
127 simp only [S, Nat.pow_zero, Int.natCast_one, isum_one, Int.zero_mul, Int.add_zero]
128 congr 1
129
130/-- Folding the upper half in: a sum of `2^(k+1)` cells is two sums of `2^k` cells. -/
131private theorem S_succ {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) {k : Nat} (hk : k < p) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat)
132 (t : Int) :
133 S bd M0 b (k + 1) t = S bd M0 b k t + S bd M0 b k (t + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)) := by
134 simp only [S, wk_succ]
135 rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm, isum_even_odd, wk_eq hbd hk]
136 congr 1
137 · apply isum_congr
138 intro m
139 congr 1
140 simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Int.ofNat_two]
141 ac_rfl
142 · apply isum_congr
143 intro m
144 congr 1
145 simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Int.ofNat_two]
146 rw [Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul]
147 have e : m * (2 * ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)) = 2 * m * ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int) := by ac_rfl
148 rw [e]
149 omega
150
151/-- `2^k` copies of the width of the region are the block. -/
152private theorem wk_mul {bd p k : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) (hk : k ≤ p) : 2 ^ k * wk bd k = bd := by
153 subst hbd
154 exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 hk)
155
156/-- A partial sum of `2^k` cells of at most 24 bits. -/
157private theorem S_bounds {gd bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) (M0 : Mem) {b : Nat} (hb : b < gd)
158 (hsrc : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < ((gd * bd : Nat) : Int) → -2 ^ 23 ≤ M0 "src" i ∧ M0 "src" i < 2 ^ 23)
159 {k : Nat} (hk : k ≤ p) (t : Int) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t < wk bd k) :
160 ((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int) * (-2 ^ 23) ≤ S bd M0 b k t ∧ S bd M0 b k t ≤ ((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int) * (2 ^ 23 - 1) := by
161 have hbb : b * bd + bd ≤ gd * bd := by
162 have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right bd hb
163 rw [Nat.succ_mul] at this
164 exact this
165 have hw := wk_mul hbd hk
166 apply isum_bounds
167 intro m hm0 hm
168 have hmw : m * ((wk bd k : Nat) : Int) ≤ (((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int) - 1) * ((wk bd k : Nat) : Int) :=
169 Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by omega) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
170 rw [Int.sub_mul, Int.one_mul, ← Int.natCast_mul, hw] at hmw
171 have := Int.mul_nonneg hm0 (Int.natCast_nonneg (wk bd k))
172 have hg : gid bd b 0 = b * bd := by unfold gid; omega
173 have := hsrc (((gid bd b 0 : Nat) : Int) + t + m * ((wk bd k : Nat) : Int)) (by rw [hg]; omega)
174 (by rw [hg]; omega)
175 omega
176

388/-- The invariant after `k` turns. -/
389private theorem inv_iter {p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) (ids : Nat → Ids)
390 (hids : ∀ t, ids t = launchIds gd bd b t) (hb : b < gd) (h256 : bd ≤ 256)

Each block reverses its own segment of $\mathit{src}$ through shared memory.
CUDA · kernels/block_reverse.cu · 9 lines
1__global__ void block_reverse(int* out, int* src, int n) {
2 __shared__ int s[256];
3 int tid = threadIdx.x;
4 int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + tid;
5 if (i < n) s[tid] = src[i];
6 __syncthreads();
7 int j = blockDim.x - 1 - tid;
8 if (i < n) out[i] = s[j];
9}
Contract · 7 lines
block_reverse(int* out, int* src, int n) 1-D launch✓ proved
RequiresblockDim ≤ 256
Requiresn = gridDim · blockDim
RequiresgridDim · blockDim ≤ 231
Ensures∀ t, 0 ≤ t ⇒ t < blockDim ⇒ out[b · blockDim + t] = src[b · blockDim + (blockDim − 1 − t)]
No data race (two threads touch a cell only if both read it or both add to it atomically); barriers are uniform; every loop terminates; no int operation overflows or divides by zero; every shared-memory access is in bounds. Every int parameter and cell is assumed to hold a 32-bit value, as its type says.

10/-- Reverses each block's segment of `src` into `out` through shared memory: cell `t` of block
11`b` receives cell `blockDim − 1 − t` of the same block. -/
12contract block_reverse (out : int*) (src : int*) (n : int) where
13 requires blockDim ≤ 256
14 requires n = gridDim * blockDim
15 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
16 ensures ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t < blockDim → out[b * blockDim + t] = src[b * blockDim + (blockDim - 1 - t)]
17 when 0 ≤ b < gridDim
18 ensures ∀ i, (i < 0 ∨ n ≤ i) → out[i] = old(out[i])
19 unchanged src

25 if ((gid bd b t : Nat) : Int) < args "n" then
26 [.read "src" (gid bd b t), .write "s" t (M0 "src" (gid bd b t))]

Inclusive prefix sum within each block: $\mathit{out}_{b,t} = \sum_{j \le t} \mathit{src}_{b,j}$.
CUDA · kernels/scan.cu · 15 lines
1__global__ void scan(int* out, int* src) {
2 __shared__ int s[256];
3 int tid = threadIdx.x;
4 int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + tid;
5 s[tid] = src[i];
6 __syncthreads();
7 for (int d = 1; d < blockDim.x; d *= 2) {
8 int v = 0;
9 if (tid >= d) v = s[tid - d];
10 __syncthreads();
11 s[tid] += v;
12 __syncthreads();
13 }
14 out[i] = s[tid];
15}

No data race (two threads touch a cell only if both read it or both add to it atomically); barriers are uniform; every loop terminates; no int operation overflows or divides by zero; every shared-memory access is in bounds. Every int parameter and cell is assumed to hold a 32-bit value, as its type says.

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Phases
3import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
4import Generated.Scan
5
6namespace Specs.Scan
7
8open Gellar.Kernel Generated.Scan
9
10/-- Inclusive prefix sum of each block's `blockDim` cells (Hillis–Steele in shared memory):
11`out[i]` is the sum of the block's cells up to and including `i`. Every partial sum is a sum
12of at most 256 cells, so cells of at most 24 bits keep the sums in `int`. -/
13contract scan (out : int*) (src : int*) where
14 requires blockDim ≤ 256
15 requires ∃ p : Nat, blockDim = 2 ^ p
16 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
17 requires -2^23 ≤ src[i] ∧ src[i] < 2^23 when 0 ≤ i < gridDim * blockDim
18 ensures ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t < blockDim → out[b * blockDim + t] = sum j < t + 1, src[b * blockDim + j]
19 when 0 ≤ b < gridDim
20 ensures ∀ (i : Int), (i < 0 ∨ gridDim * blockDim ≤ i) → out[i] = old(out[i])
21 unchanged src
22
23/-! ## Proof
24
25The loop runs `p` turns of two phases each. After `k` turns the stride is `2^k` and `s[t]`
26holds the sum of the `2^k` cells ending at `t` (fewer at the start of the block). -/
27
28/-- How many cells `s[t]` sums after `k` turns. -/
29private def cnt (k t : Nat) : Nat := min (2 ^ k) (t + 1)
30
31/-- The partial sum in `s[t]` after `k` turns. -/
32private def S (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b k t : Nat) : Int :=
33 isum 0 (cnt k t : Nat) fun j => M0 "src" (((gid bd b 0 : Nat) : Int) + t - j)
34
35/-- `s[t]` after `k` turns, for every `t`: the partial sum below `bd`, untouched garbage above. -/
36private def S' (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b k t : Nat) : Int :=
37 if t < bd then S bd M0 b k t else M0 "s" t
38
39/-- What thread `t` fetches in turn `k + 1`: `s` `2^k` cells to its left, or nothing. -/
40private def V (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b k t : Nat) : Int :=
41 if 2 ^ k ≤ t then S' bd M0 b k (t - 2 ^ k) else 0
42
43/-- Phase 0, thread `t`: stage `src[g]` in `s[t]`. -/
44private abbrev P0 (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
45 [.read "src" (gid bd b t), .write "s" t (M0 "src" (gid bd b t))]
46
47/-- Turn `k + 1`, first phase: fetch. -/
48private abbrev Qa (bd : Nat) (k : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
49 if ((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int) ≤ (t : Int) then [.read "s" ((t : Int) - ((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int))] else []
50
51/-- Turn `k + 1`, second phase: add. -/
52private abbrev Qb (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
53 [.read "s" t, .write "s" t (S' bd M0 b k t + V bd M0 b k t)]
54
55/-- The last phase: every thread writes its cell. -/
56private abbrev Pf (bd : Nat) (M0 : Mem) (b p : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
57 [.read "s" t, .write "out" (gid bd b t) (S' bd M0 b p t)]
58
59/-- The locals after `k` turns, with `v` whatever it last was. -/
60private abbrev envk (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (b k t : Nat) (v : Int) : Env := fun y =>
61 if y = "d" then ((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int) else if y = "v" then v
62 else if y = "i" then ((gid bd b t : Nat) : Int) else if y = "tid" then (t : Int) else args y
63
64/-- One turn of the loop, as the lockstep semantics runs it. -/
65private abbrev F (bd : Nat) (ids : Nat → Ids) : Block → Block := fun x =>
66 Block.each ids (Stm.assign "d" (.bin .mul (.var "d") (.lit 2)))
67 (Block.commit bd
68 (Block.each ids
69 (Stm.store "s" (.var "tid") (.bin .add (.load "s" (.var "tid")) (.var "v")))
70 (Block.commit bd
71 (Block.each ids
72 (Stm.ite (.bin .le (.var "d") (.var "tid"))
73 (Stm.assign "v" (.load "s" (.bin .sub (.var "tid") (.var "d")))) Stm.skip)
74 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "v" (.lit 0))
75 (x.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.var "d") (.blockDim .x))))))))
76
77/-- The loop invariant after `k` turns. -/
78private structure Inv (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) (B : Block) : Prop where
79 ok : B.ok = true
80 env : ∀ t, ∃ v, (B.ts t).env = envk bd args b k t v
81 log : ∀ t, (B.ts t).log = []
82 tok : ∀ t < bd, (B.ts t).ok = true
83 tmem : ∀ t, (B.ts t).mem = B.mem
84 s : ∀ t : Nat, B.mem "s" t = S' bd M0 b k t
85 other : ∀ a, a ≠ "s" → ∀ i, B.mem a i = M0 a i
86 phases : B.phases = P0 bd M0 b :: (List.range k).flatMap fun j => [Qa bd j, Qb bd M0 b j]
87

447 (hids : ∀ t, ids t = launchIds gd bd b t) (hb : b < gd) (h256 : bd ≤ 256)

455 intro hk

1__global__ void transpose(int* out, int* src, int rows, int cols) {
2 __shared__ int tile[256];
3 int tx = threadIdx.x;
4 int ty = threadIdx.y;
5 int x = blockIdx.x * 16 + tx;
6 int y = blockIdx.y * 16 + ty;
7 if (x < cols && y < rows) tile[ty * 16 + tx] = src[y * cols + x];
8 __syncthreads();
9 int x2 = blockIdx.y * 16 + tx;
10 int y2 = blockIdx.x * 16 + ty;
11 if (x2 < rows && y2 < cols) out[y2 * rows + x2] = tile[tx * 16 + ty];
12}

11/-- Tiled transpose: each `16 × 16` block stages its tile of the `rows × cols` matrix `src` in
12shared memory, synchronises, and writes the tile transposed into the `cols × rows` matrix
13`out`, so that both the reads and the writes of global memory run along rows. -/
14contract transpose (out : int*) (src : int*) (rows : int) (cols : int) where
15 launch 2D
16 requires blockDim.x = 16
17 requires blockDim.y = 16
18 requires cols ≤ gridDim.x * 16
19 requires rows ≤ gridDim.y * 16
20 requires gridDim.x * 16 ≤ 2^31
21 requires gridDim.y * 16 ≤ 2^31
22 requires rows * cols ≤ 2^31
23 ensures out[c * rows + r] = src[r * cols + c] when 0 ≤ c < cols, 0 ≤ r < rows
24 ensures ∀ (i : Int), (i < 0 ∨ cols * rows ≤ i) → out[i] = old(out[i])
25 unchanged src

27/-! ## Proof
28
29Thread `t` of block `b` is at `(tx, ty) = (t % 16, t / 16)` in the block and the block at
30`(bx, by) = (b % gdx, b / gdx)` in the grid. Phase 1 stages `src[y][x]` in `tile[ty][tx]`;
31phase 2 writes `tile[tx][ty]`, which thread `(ty, tx)` staged, to `out[y2][x2]` with the block
32coordinates swapped. All index arithmetic is by `16`, so `omega` settles it. -/

34variable (gdx gdy : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat)
35
36/-- The launch: `gdx × gdy` blocks of `16 × 16` threads. -/
37private abbrev ids : Nat → Nat → Ids := launchIds3 ⟨gdx, gdy, 1⟩ ⟨16, 16, 1⟩
38
39private abbrev TX (t : Nat) : Int := ((t % 16 : Nat) : Int)
40private abbrev TY (t : Nat) : Int := ((t / 16 % 16 : Nat) : Int)
41private abbrev BX : Int := ((b % gdx : Nat) : Int)
42private abbrev BY : Int := ((b / gdx % gdy : Nat) : Int)
43private abbrev X (t : Nat) : Int := BX gdx b * 16 + TX t
44private abbrev Y (t : Nat) : Int := BY gdx gdy b * 16 + TY t
45private abbrev X2 (t : Nat) : Int := BY gdx gdy b * 16 + TX t
46private abbrev Y2 (t : Nat) : Int := BX gdx b * 16 + TY t
47
48/-- Phase 1, thread `t`: stage `src[y][x]` in `tile[ty][tx]`. -/
49private abbrev P1 : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
50 if X gdx b t < args "cols" ∧ Y gdx gdy b t < args "rows" then
51 [.read "src" (Y gdx gdy b t * args "cols" + X gdx b t),
52 .write "tile" (TY t * 16 + TX t) (M0 "src" (Y gdx gdy b t * args "cols" + X gdx b t))]
53 else []
54
55/-- Memory after the barrier. -/
56private abbrev M1 : Mem := applyLog M0 ((List.range (16 * 16)).flatMap (P1 gdx gdy args M0 b))
57
58/-- Phase 2, thread `t`: write `tile[tx][ty]` to `out[y2][x2]`. -/
59private abbrev P2 : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
60 if X2 gdx gdy b t < args "rows" ∧ Y2 gdx b t < args "cols" then
61 [.read "tile" (TX t * 16 + TY t),
62 .write "out" (Y2 gdx b t * args "rows" + X2 gdx gdy b t) (M1 gdx gdy args M0 b "tile" (TX t * 16 + TY t))]
63 else []
64

67private theorem block_shape (hb : b < gdx * gdy) (hgx : gdx * 16 ≤ 2 ^ 31) (hgy : gdy * 16 ≤ 2 ^ 31)
68 (hrc : args "rows" * args "cols" ≤ 2 ^ 31) (hM0 : transpose.mem0 mem sh b = M0) :
69 (transpose.block (gdx * gdy) (16 * 16) (ids gdx gdy) args mem sh fl b).phases =
70 [P1 gdx gdy args M0 b, P2 gdx gdy args M0 b] ∧
71 (transpose.block (gdx * gdy) (16 * 16) (ids gdx gdy) args mem sh fl b).ok = true ∧
72 ∀ t < 16 * 16, ((transpose.block (gdx * gdy) (16 * 16) (ids gdx gdy) args mem sh fl b).ts t).ok = true := by

74 rw [hM0]
75 simp only [ids]
76 unfold_block transpose

78 · simp only [Block.commit_mem]
79 unfold_block transpose

81 -- point inside the matrix is below `rows * cols`.
82 have hg : 0 < gdx := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by subst h; simp at hb
83 have hgy' : 0 < gdy := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by subst h; simp at hb
84 have hbx := Nat.mod_lt b hg
85 have hby := Nat.mod_lt (b / gdx) hgy'
86 have htx := Nat.mod_lt t (by omega : 0 < 16)
87 have hty := Nat.mod_lt (t / 16) (by omega : 0 < 16)

1__global__ void matmul_naive(int* C, int* A, int* B, int n, int m, int p) {
2 int col = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
3 int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
4 if (row < n && col < p) {
5 int s = 0;
6 for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) s += A[row * m + k] * B[k * p + col];
7 C[row * p + col] = s;
8 }
9}

No data race (two threads touch a cell only if both read it or both add to it atomically); barriers are uniform; every loop terminates; no int operation overflows or divides by zero; every shared-memory access is in bounds. Every int parameter and cell is assumed to hold a 32-bit value, as its type says.

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Pointwise
3import Gellar.Kernel.Grid
4import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
5import Generated.MatmulNaive
6
7namespace Specs.MatmulNaive
8
9open Gellar.Kernel Generated.MatmulNaive
10
11/-- `C ← A·B` for an `n × m` matrix `A` and an `m × p` matrix `B`, all row-major; one thread
12of a two-dimensional launch per element of `C`, each running the inner product as a loop in
13`int`: the coordinates, the linear indices, every product and every partial sum must fit. -/
14contract matmul_naive (C : int*) (A : int*) (B : int*) (n : int) (m : int) (p : int) where
15 launch 2D
16 requires p ≤ gridDim.x * blockDim.x
17 requires n ≤ gridDim.y * blockDim.y
18 requires gridDim.x * blockDim.x ≤ 2^31
19 requires gridDim.y * blockDim.y ≤ 2^31
20 requires n * m ≤ 2^31
21 requires m * p ≤ 2^31
22 requires n * p ≤ 2^31
23 requires int32 (A[i * m + k] * B[k * p + j]) when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ j < p, 0 ≤ k < m
24 requires int32 (sum k < K, A[i * m + k] * B[k * p + j]) when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ j < p, 0 ≤ K < m + 1
25 ensures C[i * p + j] = sum k < m, A[i * m + k] * B[k * p + j] when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ j < p
26 ensures ∀ (c : Int), (c < 0 ∨ n * p ≤ c) → C[c] = old(C[c])
27 unchanged A
28 unchanged B
29
30/-! ## Proof -/
31
32variable (gdx gdy bdx bdy : Nat) (args : Env) (mem : Mem) (sh : Nat → Mem) (fl : FStore)
33
34/-- The launch: `gdx × gdy` blocks of `bdx × bdy` threads. -/
35private abbrev ids : Nat → Nat → Ids := launchIds3 ⟨gdx, gdy, 1⟩ ⟨bdx, bdy, 1⟩
36
37/-- The element at row `r`, column `c`. -/
38private abbrev cell (r c : Int) : Int :=
39 isum 0 (args "m") fun k => mem "A" (r * args "m" + k) * mem "B" (k * args "p" + c)
40
41/-- One turn of the loop: the condition's reads, then the body as generated. -/
42private abbrev turn (ids : Ids) : TState → TState :=
43 fun st => (Stm.seq
44 (.assign "s" (.bin .add (.var "s") (.bin .mul
45 (.load "A" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "row") (.var "m")) (.var "k")))
46 (.load "B" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "k") (.var "p")) (.var "col"))))))
47 (.assign "k" (.bin .add (.var "k") (.lit 1)))).exec ids
48 (st.reads ids (.bin .lt (.var "k") (.var "m")))
49
50/-- The reads of the first `n` turns. -/
51private abbrev turnReads (r c : Int) (k₀ : Int) (n : Nat) : List Access :=
52 (List.range n).flatMap fun (k' : Nat) =>
53 [.read "A" (r * args "m" + (k₀ + (k' : Int))), .read "B" ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * args "p" + c)]
54
55/-- The checks of turn `k'` at row `r`, column `c`, from `k₀`: the two indices and the product
56fit, the partial sum with the product fits, and the counter can step. -/
57private abbrev fitsTurn (r c k₀ s₀ : Int) (k' : Nat) : Prop :=
58 int32 (r * args "m") ∧ int32 (r * args "m" + (k₀ + (k' : Int))) ∧
59 int32 ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * args "p") ∧ int32 ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * args "p" + c) ∧
60 int32 (mem "A" (r * args "m" + (k₀ + (k' : Int))) * mem "B" ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * args "p" + c)) ∧
61 int32 (s₀ + isum k₀ (k₀ + k') (fun k => mem "A" (r * args "m" + k) * mem "B" (k * args "p" + c)) +
62 mem "A" (r * args "m" + (k₀ + (k' : Int))) * mem "B" ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * args "p" + c)) ∧
63 int32 (k₀ + (k' : Int) + 1)
64
65/-- After `n` turns whose checks pass: `s` holds `n` more products, `k` has grown by `n`,
66memory is untouched, the log has grown by reads of `A` and `B`, and no check failed. -/
67private theorem matmul_iter (ids : Ids) (n : Nat) (r c : Int) (env : Env) (fenv : FEnv) (fmem : FMem)
68 (log : List Access) (ok : Bool) (hr : env "row" = r) (hc : env "col" = c) (hm : env "m" = args "m")
69 (hp : env "p" = args "p") (hfit : ∀ k' < n, fitsTurn args mem r c (env "k") (env "s") k') :
70 iter (turn ids) n ⟨env, mem, fenv, fmem, log, ok⟩ =
71 ⟨fun v => if v = "k" then env "k" + n
72 else if v = "s" then env "s" + isum (env "k") (env "k" + n)
73 (fun k => mem "A" (r * args "m" + k) * mem "B" (k * args "p" + c))
74 else env v,
75 mem, fenv, fmem, log ++ turnReads args r c (env "k") n, ok⟩ := by
76 induction n with
77 | zero =>
78 simp only [iter, isum_of_le (Int.le_refl _), Int.add_zero, turnReads, List.range_zero,
79 List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, Int.natCast_zero]
80 congr
81 funext v
82 by_cases hk : v = "k" <;> by_cases hs : v = "s" <;> simp [hk, hs]
83 | succ n ih =>
84 rw [iter_succ_apply, ih (fun k' hk' => hfit k' (by omega))]

$C = AB$ for $n \times n$ matrices, with $16 \times 16$ shared-memory tiles across barriers.
CUDA · kernels/matmul_tiled.cu · 17 lines
1__global__ void matmul_tiled(int* C, int* A, int* B, int n) {
2 __shared__ int As[256];
3 __shared__ int Bs[256];
4 int tx = threadIdx.x;
5 int ty = threadIdx.y;
6 int row = blockIdx.y * 16 + ty;
7 int col = blockIdx.x * 16 + tx;
8 int s = 0;
9 for (int k0 = 0; k0 < n; k0 += 16) {
10 As[ty * 16 + tx] = A[row * n + (k0 + tx)];
11 Bs[ty * 16 + tx] = B[(k0 + ty) * n + col];
12 __syncthreads();
13 for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) s += As[ty * 16 + k] * Bs[k * 16 + tx];
14 __syncthreads();
15 }
16 C[row * n + col] = s;
17}

matmul_tiled(int* C, int* A, int* B, int n) 2-D launch✓ proved

No data race (two threads touch a cell only if both read it or both add to it atomically); barriers are uniform; every loop terminates; no int operation overflows or divides by zero; every shared-memory access is in bounds. Every int parameter and cell is assumed to hold a 32-bit value, as its type says.

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Phases
3import Gellar.Kernel.Grid
4import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
5import Generated.MatmulTiled
6
7namespace Specs.MatmulTiled
8
9open Gellar.Kernel Generated.MatmulTiled
10
11/-- Tiled matrix multiply, `C ← A·B` for square `n × n` matrices with `n` a multiple of 16: a
12`16 × 16` block computes one tile of `C`, walking the `n / 16` tiles of its row of `A` and its
13column of `B` through shared memory, with one barrier after loading a pair of tiles and one
14after using them. The indices, every product and every partial sum of a row by a column
15are computed in `int` and must fit. -/
16contract matmul_tiled (C : int*) (A : int*) (B : int*) (n : int) where
17 launch 2D
18 requires blockDim.x = 16
19 requires blockDim.y = 16
20 requires gridDim.y = gridDim.x
21 requires n = gridDim.x * 16
22 requires n * n ≤ 2^31
23 requires int32 (A[i * n + k] * B[k * n + j]) when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ j < n, 0 ≤ k < n
24 requires int32 (sum k < K, A[i * n + k] * B[k * n + j]) when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ j < n, 0 ≤ K < n + 1
25 ensures C[i * n + j] = sum k < n, A[i * n + k] * B[k * n + j] when 0 ≤ i < n, 0 ≤ j < n
26 ensures ∀ (c : Int), (c < 0 ∨ n * n ≤ c) → C[c] = old(C[c])
27 unchanged A
28 unchanged B
29
30/-! ## Proof
31
32Thread `t` of block `b` is at `(tx, ty) = (t % 16, t / 16)` and computes `C[row][col]` with
33`row = by * 16 + ty`, `col = bx * 16 + tx`. Turn `q` of the outer loop loads tile `q` of the
34block's row of `A` and column of `B` into `As`, `Bs` (phase `QA q`), synchronises, has every
35thread add 16 products from the tiles into `s` (phase `QB`), and synchronises again. The
36invariant after `q` turns: `s` holds the first `16 q` products of the row by the column. -/
37
38variable (gdx : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (FA : FEnv) (FM0 : FMem) (b : Nat)
39
40/-- The launch: `gdx × gdx` blocks of `16 × 16` threads. -/
41private abbrev ids : Nat → Nat → Ids := launchIds3 ⟨gdx, gdx, 1⟩ ⟨16, 16, 1⟩
42
43private abbrev TX (t : Nat) : Int := ((t % 16 : Nat) : Int)
44private abbrev TY (t : Nat) : Int := ((t / 16 % 16 : Nat) : Int)
45private abbrev BX : Int := ((b % gdx : Nat) : Int)
46private abbrev BY : Int := ((b / gdx % gdx : Nat) : Int)
47private abbrev ROW (t : Nat) : Int := BY gdx b * 16 + TY t
48private abbrev COL (t : Nat) : Int := BX gdx b * 16 + TX t
49
50/-- The partial sum after `q` tiles. -/
51private def S (q t : Nat) : Int :=
52 isum 0 (16 * q : Nat) fun k =>
53 M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + k) * M0 "B" (k * args "n" + COL gdx b t)
54
55/-- The loading phase of tile `q`, thread `t`. -/
56private abbrev QA (q : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
57 [.read "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + TX t)),
58 .write "As" (TY t * 16 + TX t) (M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + TX t))),
59 .read "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + TY t) * args "n" + COL gdx b t),
60 .write "Bs" (TY t * 16 + TX t) (M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + TY t) * args "n" + COL gdx b t))]
61
62/-- Memory after the first barrier of tile `q`, loaded from memory `M`. -/
63private abbrev M1 (q : Nat) (M : Mem) : Mem :=
64 applyLog M ((List.range (16 * 16)).flatMap (QA gdx args M0 b q))
65
66/-- The reads of the first `m` turns of the inner loop, from `k₀`. -/
67private abbrev ireads (ty tx k₀ : Int) (m : Nat) : List Access :=
68 (List.range m).flatMap fun (k' : Nat) =>
69 [.read "As" (ty * 16 + (k₀ + (k' : Int))), .read "Bs" ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * 16 + tx)]
70
71/-- The compute phase, thread `t`: 16 reads of each tile. -/
72private abbrev QB : Nat → List Access := fun t => ireads (TY t) (TX t) 0 16
73
74/-- The last phase, thread `t`: write `C[row][col]`. -/
75private abbrev Pf : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
76 [.write "C" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + COL gdx b t) (S gdx args M0 b gdx t)]
77
78/-- The inner counter after `q` turns: untouched before the first. -/
79private abbrev kq (q : Nat) : Int := if q = 0 then args "k" else 16
80
81/-- The locals after `q` turns. -/
82private abbrev envq (q t : Nat) : Env := fun y =>
83 if y = "k0" then 16 * (q : Int) else if y = "k" then kq args q
84 else if y = "s" then S gdx args M0 b q t
85 else if y = "col" then COL gdx b t else if y = "row" then ROW gdx b t
86 else if y = "ty" then TY t else if y = "tx" then TX t else args y
87
88/-- One turn of the outer loop, as the lockstep semantics runs it. -/
89private abbrev F (ids : Nat → Ids) : Block → Block := fun x =>
90 Block.each ids (Stm.assign "k0" (.bin .add (.var "k0") (.lit 16)))
91 (Block.commit (16 * 16)
92 (Block.each ids ((Stm.assign "k" (.lit 0)).seq
93 (Stm.loop (.bin .sub (.lit 16) (.var "k")) (.bin .lt (.var "k") (.lit 16))
94 ((Stm.assign "s" (.bin .add (.var "s") (.bin .mul
95 (.load "As" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "k")))
96 (.load "Bs" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "k") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx")))))).seq
97 (Stm.assign "k" (.bin .add (.var "k") (.lit 1))))))
98 (Block.commit (16 * 16)
99 (Block.each ids (Stm.store "Bs" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx"))
100 (.load "B" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.bin .add (.var "k0") (.var "ty")) (.var "n")) (.var "col"))))
101 (Block.each ids (Stm.store "As" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx"))
102 (.load "A" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "row") (.var "n")) (.bin .add (.var "k0") (.var "tx")))))
103 (x.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.var "k0") (.var "n"))))))))
104
105/-- The loop invariant after `q` turns. -/
106private structure Inv (q : Nat) (B : Block) : Prop where
107 ok : B.ok = true
108 env : ∀ t, (B.ts t).env = envq gdx args M0 b q t
109 log : ∀ t, (B.ts t).log = []
110 tok : ∀ t, (B.ts t).ok = true
111 tmem : ∀ t, (B.ts t).mem = B.mem
112 other : ∀ a, a ≠ "As" → a ≠ "Bs" → ∀ i, B.mem a i = M0 a i
113 phases : B.phases = (List.range q).flatMap fun q' => [QA gdx args M0 b q', QB]
114
115/-! ### The partial sums -/
116
117private theorem S_zero (t : Nat) : S gdx args M0 b 0 t = 0 := by
118 simp [S, isum]
119
120/-- One more tile: 16 more products. -/
121private theorem S_succ (q t : Nat) :
122 S gdx args M0 b (q + 1) t = S gdx args M0 b q t + isum 0 16 fun k =>
123 M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + k)) *
124 M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + k) * args "n" + COL gdx b t) := by
125 simp only [S, Nat.mul_succ, isum_split]
126 congr 1
127
128/-- The first `16 q + m` products: `q` tiles and `m` more. -/
129private theorem S_partial (q m : Nat) (t : Nat) :
130 S gdx args M0 b q t + (isum 0 m fun k =>
131 M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + k)) * M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + k) * args "n" + COL gdx b t)) =
132 isum 0 ((16 * q + m : Nat) : Int) fun k =>
133 M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + k) * M0 "B" (k * args "n" + COL gdx b t) := by
134 rw [S, isum_split]
135 congr 1
136 try apply isum_congr
137 try intro k
138 try push_cast
139 try rfl
140
141/-! ### The inner loop, in one thread -/
142
143/-- One turn of the inner loop: the condition's reads, then the body. -/
144private abbrev iturn (ids : Ids) : TState → TState := fun st =>
145 ((Stm.assign "s" (.bin .add (.var "s") (.bin .mul
146 (.load "As" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "k")))
147 (.load "Bs" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "k") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx")))))).seq
148 (Stm.assign "k" (.bin .add (.var "k") (.lit 1)))).exec ids
149 (st.reads ids (.bin .lt (.var "k") (.lit 16)))
150
151/-- The checks of turn `k'` of the inner loop, from `k₀` with `s = s₀`, in the tiles `M`. -/
152private abbrev fitsInner (M : Mem) (ty tx k₀ s₀ : Int) (k' : Nat) : Prop :=
153 int32 (ty * 16) ∧ int32 (ty * 16 + (k₀ + (k' : Int))) ∧
154 int32 ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * 16) ∧ int32 ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * 16 + tx) ∧
155 int32 (M "As" (ty * 16 + (k₀ + (k' : Int))) * M "Bs" ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * 16 + tx)) ∧
156 int32 (s₀ + isum k₀ (k₀ + k') (fun k => M "As" (ty * 16 + k) * M "Bs" (k * 16 + tx)) +
157 M "As" (ty * 16 + (k₀ + (k' : Int))) * M "Bs" ((k₀ + (k' : Int)) * 16 + tx)) ∧
158 int32 (k₀ + (k' : Int) + 1)
159
160private theorem inner_iter (ids : Ids) (m : Nat) (M : Mem) (ty tx : Int) (env : Env) (fenv : FEnv)
161 (fmem : FMem) (log : List Access) (ok : Bool) (hty : env "ty" = ty) (htx : env "tx" = tx)
162 (hfit : ∀ k' < m, fitsInner M ty tx (env "k") (env "s") k') :
163 iter (iturn ids) m ⟨env, M, fenv, fmem, log, ok⟩ =
164 ⟨fun v => if v = "k" then env "k" + m
165 else if v = "s" then env "s" + isum (env "k") (env "k" + m)
166 (fun k => M "As" (ty * 16 + k) * M "Bs" (k * 16 + tx))
167 else env v,
168 M, fenv, fmem, log ++ ireads ty tx (env "k") m, ok⟩ := by
169 induction m with
170 | zero =>
171 simp only [iter, isum_of_le (Int.le_refl _), Int.add_zero, ireads, List.range_zero,
172 List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, Int.natCast_zero]
173 congr
174 funext v
175 by_cases hk : v = "k" <;> by_cases hs : v = "s" <;> simp [hk, hs]
176 | succ m ih =>
177 rw [iter_succ_apply, ih (fun k' hk' => hfit k' (by omega))]
178 obtain ⟨f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, f6, f7⟩ := hfit m (by omega)
179 have e1 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f1
180 have e2 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f2
181 have e3 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f3
182 have e4 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f4
183 have e5 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f5
184 have e6 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f6
185 have e7 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f7
186 simp only [iturn, Stm.exec_seq, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval, Exp.reads,
187 BinOp.eval, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits, BinOp.evalsRight, List.map, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
188 List.append_nil, List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc, hty, htx,
189 String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, ite_self, Bool.and_true, Bool.true_and, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or,
190 e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6, e7]
191 congr 1
192 · funext v
193 by_cases hk : v = "k"
194 · subst hk; simp [Int.natCast_add, Int.add_assoc]
195 · by_cases hs : v = "s"
196 · subst hs; simp [hk, Int.natCast_add, isum_succ', Int.add_assoc]
197 · simp [hk, hs]
198 · simp [ireads, List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append]
199
200/-- The inner loop, from `k = 0`: 16 products added to `s`. -/
201private theorem inner_loop (ids : Ids) (M : Mem) (ty tx : Int) (env : Env) (fenv : FEnv) (fmem : FMem)
202 (log : List Access)
203 (ok : Bool) (hty : env "ty" = ty) (htx : env "tx" = tx) (hk : env "k" = 0)
204 (hfit : ∀ k' < 16, fitsInner M ty tx 0 (env "s") k') :
205 Stm.loopRun ids (.bin .lt (.var "k") (.lit 16),
206 (Stm.assign "s" (.bin .add (.var "s") (.bin .mul
207 (.load "As" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "k")))
208 (.load "Bs" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "k") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx")))))).seq
209 (Stm.assign "k" (.bin .add (.var "k") (.lit 1)))) 16 ⟨env, M, fenv, fmem, log, ok⟩ =
210 ⟨fun v => if v = "k" then 16
211 else if v = "s" then env "s" + isum 0 16 (fun k => M "As" (ty * 16 + k) * M "Bs" (k * 16 + tx))
212 else env v,
213 M, fenv, fmem, log ++ ireads ty tx 0 16, ok⟩ := by
214 have hfit' : ∀ k' < 16, fitsInner M ty tx (env "k") (env "s") k' := by rw [hk]; exact hfit
215 rw [Stm.loopRun_eq _ _ _ _ _ 16 (Nat.le_refl _)]
216 · rw [inner_iter ids 16 M ty tx env fenv fmem log ok hty htx hfit']
217 simp only [TState.reads, Exp.reads, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits, BinOp.evalsRight, List.map, List.append_nil,
218 hk, Int.zero_add, Bool.and_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, ite_self]
219 rfl
220 · intro m hm
221 rw [inner_iter ids m M ty tx env fenv fmem log ok hty htx (fun k' hk' => hfit' k' (by omega))]
222 simp [Exp.eval, BinOp.eval, hk]
223 omega
224 · rw [inner_iter ids 16 M ty tx env fenv fmem log ok hty htx hfit']
225 simp [Exp.eval, BinOp.eval, hk]
226
227private theorem mem_ireads {ty tx k₀ : Int} {m : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ ireads ty tx k₀ m) :
228 ∃ k < m, acc = .read "As" (ty * 16 + (k₀ + (k : Int))) ∨ acc = .read "Bs" ((k₀ + (k : Int)) * 16 + tx) := by
229 simp only [ireads, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
230 obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := h
231 exact ⟨k, hk, h⟩

233/-! ### The tiles after the first barrier -/
234
235variable (q : Nat) (M : Mem)
236
237private theorem mem_QA {t : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ QA gdx args M0 b q t) :
238 acc = .read "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + TX t)) ∨
239 acc = .write "As" (TY t * 16 + TX t) (M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + TX t))) ∨
240 acc = .read "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + TY t) * args "n" + COL gdx b t) ∨
241 acc = .write "Bs" (TY t * 16 + TX t) (M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + TY t) * args "n" + COL gdx b t)) := by
242 simpa [QA] using h
243
244/-- `As[ty][k]` after the barrier: thread `(k, ty)` loaded it. -/
245private theorem M1_As (t k : Nat) (hk : k < 16) :
246 M1 gdx args M0 b q M "As" (TY t * 16 + k) =
247 M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + k)) := by
248 apply applyLog_eq_of_write
249 · intro w hw
250 simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range] at hw
251 obtain ⟨t', ht', hw⟩ := hw
252 rcases mem_QA gdx args M0 b q hw with h | h | h | h
253 · cases h
254 · simp only [Access.write.injEq, true_and] at h
255 obtain ⟨hidx, rfl⟩ := h
256 simp only [TX, TY, ROW, BY] at hidx ⊢
257 have h1 : t' % 16 = k := by omega
258 have h2 : t' / 16 % 16 = t / 16 % 16 := by omega
259 rw [h1, h2]
260 · cases h
261 · simp at h
262 · refine ⟨M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + k)), ?_⟩
263 simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range]
264 refine ⟨k + 16 * (t / 16 % 16), by omega, ?_⟩
265 have h1 : (k + 16 * (t / 16 % 16)) % 16 = k := by omega
266 have h2 : (k + 16 * (t / 16 % 16)) / 16 % 16 = t / 16 % 16 := by omega
267 simp only [QA, TX, TY, ROW, BY, h1, h2, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, true_or, or_true]
268 · intro w hw
269 simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range] at hw
270 obtain ⟨t', -, hw⟩ := hw
271 rcases mem_QA gdx args M0 b q hw with h | h | h | h <;> cases h
272
273/-- `Bs[k][tx]` after the barrier: thread `(tx, k)` loaded it. -/
274private theorem M1_Bs (t k : Nat) (hk : k < 16) :
275 M1 gdx args M0 b q M "Bs" ((k : Int) * 16 + TX t) =
276 M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + k) * args "n" + COL gdx b t) := by
277 apply applyLog_eq_of_write
278 · intro w hw
279 simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range] at hw
280 obtain ⟨t', ht', hw⟩ := hw
281 rcases mem_QA gdx args M0 b q hw with h | h | h | h
282 · cases h
283 · simp at h
284 · cases h
285 · simp only [Access.write.injEq, true_and] at h
286 obtain ⟨hidx, rfl⟩ := h
287 simp only [TX, TY, COL, BX] at hidx ⊢
288 have h1 : t' % 16 = t % 16 := by omega
289 have h2 : t' / 16 % 16 = k := by omega
290 rw [h1, h2]
291 · refine ⟨M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + k) * args "n" + COL gdx b t), ?_⟩
292 simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range]
293 refine ⟨t % 16 + 16 * k, by omega, ?_⟩
294 have h1 : (t % 16 + 16 * k) % 16 = t % 16 := by omega
295 have h2 : (t % 16 + 16 * k) / 16 % 16 = k := by omega
296 simp only [QA, TX, TY, COL, BX, h1, h2, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, or_true]
297 · intro w hw
298 simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range] at hw
299 obtain ⟨t', -, hw⟩ := hw
300 rcases mem_QA gdx args M0 b q hw with h | h | h | h <;> cases h
301
302/-- Loading the tiles touches no other array. -/
303private theorem M1_other (a : String) (ha : a ≠ "As") (hb : a ≠ "Bs") (i : Int) :
304 M1 gdx args M0 b q M a i = M a i := by
305 apply applyLog_of_not_updated
306 intro acc hacc hu
307 simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range] at hacc
308 obtain ⟨t, -, hacc⟩ := hacc
309 rcases mem_QA gdx args M0 b q hacc with h | h | h | h <;> subst h <;> simp at hu
310 · exact ha hu.1.symm
311 · exact hb hu.1.symm
312
313/-- The first `m ≤ 16` products of tile `q`, read from the tiles, are products of `A` and `B`. -/
314private theorem tile_sum' (t : Nat) (m : Nat) (hm : m ≤ 16) :
315 (isum 0 m fun k => M1 gdx args M0 b q M "As" (TY t * 16 + k) * M1 gdx args M0 b q M "Bs" (k * 16 + TX t)) =
316 isum 0 m fun k => M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + k)) *
317 M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + k) * args "n" + COL gdx b t) := by
318 apply isum_congr_on
319 intro k hk0 hk
320 obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hk0
321 rw [M1_As gdx args M0 b q M t k (by omega), M1_Bs gdx args M0 b q M t k (by omega)]
322
323/-- The 16 products of tile `q`, read from the tiles, are products of `A` and `B`. -/
324private theorem tile_sum (t : Nat) :
325 (isum 0 16 fun k => M1 gdx args M0 b q M "As" (TY t * 16 + k) * M1 gdx args M0 b q M "Bs" (k * 16 + TX t)) =
326 isum 0 16 fun k => M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + k)) *
327 M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + k) * args "n" + COL gdx b t) :=
328 tile_sum' gdx args M0 b q M t 16 (Nat.le_refl _)
329
330/-- Thread `t` of block `b` is inside the matrix. -/
331private theorem coords_lt' (hn : args "n" = gdx * 16) (hb : b < gdx * gdx) (t : Nat) :
332 0 ≤ ROW gdx b t ∧ ROW gdx b t < args "n" ∧ 0 ≤ COL gdx b t ∧ COL gdx b t < args "n" := by
333 have hg : 0 < gdx := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by subst h; simp at hb
334 have hbx := Nat.mod_lt b hg
335 have hby := Nat.mod_lt (b / gdx) hg
336 simp only [ROW, COL, BX, BY, TX, TY]
337 omega
338
339/-- The checks of the inner loop's turns pass in tile `q`: the tiles hold products of `A` and
340`B` below `int`, and the running sum is a prefix of the row by the column. -/
341private theorem fits_inner (hn : args "n" = gdx * 16) (hb : b < gdx * gdx) (hq : q < gdx)
342 (hprod : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → ∀ j : Int, 0 ≤ j → j < args "n" →
343 ∀ k : Int, 0 ≤ k → k < args "n" → int32 (M0 "A" (i * args "n" + k) * M0 "B" (k * args "n" + j)))
344 (hsum : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → ∀ j : Int, 0 ≤ j → j < args "n" →
345 ∀ K : Int, 0 ≤ K → K < args "n" + 1 →
346 int32 (isum 0 K fun k => M0 "A" (i * args "n" + k) * M0 "B" (k * args "n" + j)))
347 (t : Nat) : ∀ k' < 16, fitsInner (M1 gdx args M0 b q M) (TY t) (TX t) 0 (S gdx args M0 b q t) k' := by
348 intro k' hk'
349 obtain ⟨hr0, hr, hc0, hc⟩ := coords_lt' gdx args b hn hb t
350 have htx := Nat.mod_lt t (by omega : 0 < 16)
351 have hty := Nat.mod_lt (t / 16) (by omega : 0 < 16)
352 have hA := M1_As gdx args M0 b q M t k' hk'
353 have hB := M1_Bs gdx args M0 b q M t k' hk'
354 have hp := hprod _ hr0 hr _ hc0 hc (16 * (q : Int) + k') (by omega) (by omega)
355 have hs := hsum _ hr0 hr _ hc0 hc (((16 * q + k' : Nat) : Int) + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
356 have hsucc := isum_zero_succ (16 * q + k') fun k =>
357 M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + k) * M0 "B" (k * args "n" + COL gdx b t)
358 rw [Int.natCast_add, Int.natCast_one] at hsucc
359 rw [hsucc, ← S_partial gdx args M0 b q k' t] at hs
360 simp only [fitsInner, Int.zero_add, hA, hB, tile_sum' gdx args M0 b q M t k' (Nat.le_of_lt hk')]
361 simp only [TX, TY]
362 push_cast at hs
363 refine ⟨by unfold int32; omega, by unfold int32; omega, by unfold int32; omega, by unfold int32; omega,
364 hp, hs, by unfold int32; omega⟩
365
366/-! ### The invariant -/
367
368/-- The block at the loop's entry. -/
369private theorem inv_entry (ids : Nat → Ids) (hids : ∀ t, ids t = launchIds3 ⟨gdx, gdx, 1⟩ ⟨16, 16, 1⟩ b t)
370 (hn : args "n" = gdx * 16) (hb : b < gdx * gdx) (hn16 : args "n" ≤ 2 ^ 16) :
371 Inv gdx args M0 b 0
372 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "k0" (.lit 0))
373 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "s" (.lit 0))
374 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "col" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.blockIdx .x) (.lit 16)) (.var "tx")))
375 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "row" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.blockIdx .y) (.lit 16)) (.var "ty")))
376 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "ty" (.threadIdx .y))
377 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "tx" (.threadIdx .x))
378 ⟨M0, FM0, fun _ => ⟨args, M0, FA, FM0, [], true⟩, [], true⟩)))))) := by
379 refine ⟨rfl, fun t => ?_, fun t => ?_, fun t => ?_, fun t => rfl, fun a _ _ i => rfl, rfl⟩
380 · simp only [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval,
381 BinOp.eval, hids, launchIds3_tid, launchIds3_bid, Dim3.get_x, Dim3.get_y, Dim3.coords_x,
382 Dim3.coords_y, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
383 funext y
384 simp only [envq, kq, S_zero, Int.natCast_zero, Int.mul_zero, TX, TY, COL, ROW, BX, BY]
385 by_cases h0 : y = "k0" <;> by_cases h1 : y = "k" <;> by_cases h2 : y = "s" <;>
386 by_cases h3 : y = "col" <;> by_cases h4 : y = "row" <;> by_cases h5 : y = "ty" <;>
387 by_cases h6 : y = "tx" <;> simp [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]
388 · simp [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.reads, BinOp.evalsRight]
389 · -- No thread overflows: its coordinates are below `n`.
390 obtain ⟨hr0, hr, hc0, hc⟩ := coords_lt' gdx args b hn hb t
391 simp only [ROW, COL, BX, BY, TX, TY] at hr0 hr hc0 hc
392 simp only [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits,
393 BinOp.evalsRight, BinOp.eval, hids, launchIds3_tid, launchIds3_bid, Dim3.get_x, Dim3.get_y,
394 Dim3.coords_x, Dim3.coords_y, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, Bool.and_true, Bool.true_and,
395 Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, Bool.and_eq_true, int32b_eq_true]
396 fits

398/-- The locals after one more turn. -/
399private theorem envq_succ (q t : Nat) :
400 (fun y => if y = "k0" then 16 * (q : Int) + 16
401 else if y = "k" then 16 else if y = "s" then S gdx args M0 b (q + 1) t else envq gdx args M0 b q t y) =
402 envq gdx args M0 b (q + 1) t := by
403 funext y
404 by_cases h0 : y = "k0"
405 · subst h0
406 simp only [envq, ↓reduceIte]

408 omega
409 · by_cases h1 : y = "k"
410 · subst h1
411 simp only [envq, kq, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, Nat.succ_ne_zero]
412 · by_cases h2 : y = "s"
413 · subst h2
414 simp only [envq, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
415 · simp only [envq, h0, h1, h2, ↓reduceIte]

417/-- One turn keeps the invariant. -/
418private theorem inv_step (ids : Nat → Ids) (hn : args "n" = gdx * 16) (hb : b < gdx * gdx)
419 (hnn : args "n" * args "n" ≤ 2 ^ 31) (hn16 : args "n" ≤ 2 ^ 16)
420 (hprod : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → ∀ j : Int, 0 ≤ j → j < args "n" →
421 ∀ k : Int, 0 ≤ k → k < args "n" → int32 (M0 "A" (i * args "n" + k) * M0 "B" (k * args "n" + j)))
422 (hsum : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → ∀ j : Int, 0 ≤ j → j < args "n" →
423 ∀ K : Int, 0 ≤ K → K < args "n" + 1 →
424 int32 (isum 0 K fun k => M0 "A" (i * args "n" + k) * M0 "B" (k * args "n" + j)))
425 {q : Nat} (hq : q < gdx) {B : Block} (h : Inv gdx args M0 b q B) :
426 Inv gdx args M0 b (q + 1) (F ids B) := by
427 -- The indices of the loads fit: the row and column are below `n`, as is `16 q + 15`.
428 have hidx : ∀ t, int32 (TY t * 16) ∧ int32 (TY t * 16 + TX t) ∧ int32 (ROW gdx b t * args "n") ∧
429 int32 (16 * (q : Int) + TX t) ∧ int32 (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + TX t)) ∧
430 int32 (16 * (q : Int) + TY t) ∧ int32 ((16 * (q : Int) + TY t) * args "n") ∧
431 int32 ((16 * (q : Int) + TY t) * args "n" + COL gdx b t) := by

443 (by omega : (0 : Int) ≤ args "n")

445 refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> (unfold int32; omega)

449 ((Stm.store "As" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx"))
450 (.load "A" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "row") (.var "n")) (.bin .add (.var "k0") (.var "tx"))))).exec (ids t)
451 ((B.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.var "k0") (.var "n"))).ts t))) =
452 ⟨envq gdx args M0 b q t,
453 (B.mem.write "As" (TY t * 16 + TX t) (M0 "A" (ROW gdx b t * args "n" + (16 * (q : Int) + TX t)))).write "Bs"
454 (TY t * 16 + TX t) (M0 "B" ((16 * (q : Int) + TY t) * args "n" + COL gdx b t)),
455 (B.ts t).fenv, (B.ts t).fmem, QA gdx args M0 b q t, true⟩ := by

459 have e2 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f2

464 have e7 := (int32b_eq_true _).2 f7

467 Block.readAll_ts_fenv, Block.readAll_ts_fmem,
468 Stm.exec_store, TState.reads, Exp.eval, Exp.reads, BinOp.eval, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits, BinOp.evalsRight,
469 h.env, h.log, h.tmem, h.tok, envq, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, List.map, List.append_nil,

519 obtain ⟨t, -, k, -, rfl | rfl⟩ := hacc <;> rfl

521 apply applyFLog_of_reads
522 intro acc hacc
523 simp only [QB, ireads, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hacc
524 obtain ⟨t, -, k, -, rfl | rfl⟩ := hacc <;> rfl
525 -- The block after the first barrier, as a literal.
526 have hC1 : Block.commit (16 * 16) (Block.each ids (Stm.store "Bs" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx"))
527 (.load "B" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.bin .add (.var "k0") (.var "ty")) (.var "n")) (.var "col"))))
528 (Block.each ids (Stm.store "As" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx"))
529 (.load "A" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "row") (.var "n")) (.bin .add (.var "k0") (.var "tx")))))
530 (B.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.var "k0") (.var "n"))))) =
531 ⟨M1 gdx args M0 b q B.mem, B.fmem,
532 fun t => ⟨envq gdx args M0 b q t, M1 gdx args M0 b q B.mem, (B.ts t).fenv, B.fmem, [], true⟩,

539 (Stm.loop (.bin .sub (.lit 16) (.var "k")) (.bin .lt (.var "k") (.lit 16))
540 ((Stm.assign "s" (.bin .add (.var "s") (.bin .mul
541 (.load "As" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "k")))
542 (.load "Bs" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "k") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx")))))).seq
543 (Stm.assign "k" (.bin .add (.var "k") (.lit 1))))))
544 (Block.commit (16 * 16) (Block.each ids (Stm.store "Bs" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.var "ty") (.lit 16)) (.var "tx"))
545 (.load "B" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.bin .add (.var "k0") (.var "ty")) (.var "n")) (.var "col"))))

709 0 ≤ ROW gdx b t ∧ ROW gdx b t < args "n" ∧ 0 ≤ COL gdx b t ∧ COL gdx b t < args "n" := by

1__global__ void histogram(int* hist, int* src, int n, int bins) {
2 int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
3 if (i < n) {
4 int v = src[i];
5 if (0 <= v && v < bins) atomicAdd(&hist[v], 1);
6 }
7}

10/-- Counts, for every bin `v`, how many of the first `n` values of `src` equal `v`; values
11outside `[0, bins)` are ignored. Threads that hit the same bin add to it with `atomicAdd`, in
12whatever order the hardware runs them; the counters must not wrap around. -/
13contract histogram (hist : int*) (src : int*) (n : int) (bins : int) where
14 requires n ≤ gridDim * blockDim
15 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
16 requires hist[v] + n < 2^31 when 0 ≤ v < bins
17 ensures hist[v] = old(hist[v]) + sum i < n, (if src[i] = v then 1 else 0) when 0 ≤ v < bins
18 ensures hist[v] = old(hist[v]) otherwise
19 unchanged src

Dot product: $\mathit{out}_0 \mathrel{+}= \sum_{i<n} x_i\,y_i$, block reductions then an atomic add.
CUDA · kernels/dot.cu · 12 lines
1__global__ void dot(int* out, int* x, int* y, int n) {
2 __shared__ int s[256];
3 int tid = threadIdx.x;
4 int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + tid;
5 if (i < n) s[tid] = x[i] * y[i]; else s[tid] = 0;
6 __syncthreads();
7 for (int d = blockDim.x / 2; d > 0; d /= 2) {
8 if (tid < d) s[tid] += s[tid + d];
9 __syncthreads();
10 }
11 if (tid == 0) atomicAdd(&out[0], s[0]);
12}

dot(int* out, int* x, int* y, int n) 1-D launch✓ proved

RequiresgridDim · blockDim ≤ 231

Requires−231 ≤ out[0] + Σi < nx[i] · y[i] < 231
Ensuresout[0] = old(out[0]) + Σi < nx[i] · y[i]

Ensuresx unchanged

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Phases
3import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
4import Generated.Dot
5
6namespace Specs.Dot
7
8open Gellar.Kernel Generated.Dot
9
10/-- Dot product in one pass: each block multiplies its `blockDim` pairs, reduces them in shared
11memory, and adds its partial sum to `out[0]` with `atomicAdd`, so the blocks' contributions
12land in any order. Products of at most 24 bits keep every block's partial sums in `int`; the
13atomic adds wrap around, so the final sum must fit too. -/
14contract dot (out : int*) (x : int*) (y : int*) (n : int) where
15 requires blockDim ≤ 256
16 requires ∃ p : Nat, blockDim = 2 ^ p
17 requires n ≤ gridDim * blockDim
18 requires gridDim * blockDim ≤ 2^31
19 requires -2^23 ≤ x[i] * y[i] ∧ x[i] * y[i] < 2^23 when 0 ≤ i < n
20 requires int32 (out[0] + sum i < n, x[i] * y[i])
21 ensures out[0] = old(out[0]) + sum i < n, x[i] * y[i]
22 ensures ∀ (i : Int), i ≠ 0 → out[i] = old(out[i])
23 unchanged x
24 unchanged y
25
26/-! ## Proof
27
28The block part is `Specs/BlockSum.lean` with a product staged in phase 0 (zero past `n`) and
29an atomic add instead of a write at the end. The loop runs `p` turns; after `k` turns the
30active stride is `dk bd k = bd / 2^(k+1)` and the first `wk bd k = bd / 2^k` cells of `s` hold
31partial sums of `2^k` products each (`S`). -/
32
33/-- The stride after `k` turns. -/
34private def dk (bd k : Nat) : Nat := bd / 2 ^ (k + 1)
35
36/-- The width of the region of `s` holding partial sums after `k` turns. -/
37private def wk (bd k : Nat) : Nat := bd / 2 ^ k
38
39/-- The product staged for global index `g`: zero past `n`. -/
40private def val (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (g : Int) : Int :=
41 if g < args "n" then M0 "x" g * M0 "y" g else 0
42
43/-- The partial sum in `s[t]` after `k` turns: `2^k` products of the block, `wk bd k` apart. -/
44private def S (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) (t : Int) : Int :=
45 isum 0 (2 ^ k : Nat) fun m => val args M0 (((gid bd b 0 : Nat) : Int) + t + m * ((wk bd k : Nat) : Int))
46
47/-- Phase 0, thread `t`: stage `x[g] * y[g]`, or `0` past `n`, in `s[t]`. -/
48private abbrev P0 (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
49 if ((gid bd b t : Nat) : Int) < args "n" then
50 [.read "x" (gid bd b t), .read "y" (gid bd b t),
51 .write "s" t (M0 "x" (gid bd b t) * M0 "y" (gid bd b t))]
52 else [.write "s" t 0]
53
54/-- The phase of turn `k + 1`, thread `t`: the active threads fold the upper half in. -/
55private abbrev Q (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
56 if (t : Int) < ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int) then
57 [.read "s" t, .read "s" ((t : Int) + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)),
58 .write "s" t (S bd args M0 b k t + S bd args M0 b k ((t : Int) + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)))]
59 else []
60
61/-- The last phase, thread `t`: thread 0 adds the block's sum to `out[0]`. -/
62private abbrev Pf (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b p : Nat) : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
63 if (t : Int) = 0 then [.read "s" 0, .atomic "out" 0 (S bd args M0 b p 0)] else []
64
65/-- The locals after `k` turns. -/
66private abbrev envk (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (b k t : Nat) : Env := fun y =>
67 if y = "d" then ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)
68 else if y = "i" then ((gid bd b t : Nat) : Int)
69 else if y = "tid" then (t : Int) else args y
70
71/-- One turn of the loop, as the lockstep semantics runs it. -/
72private abbrev F (bd : Nat) (ids : Nat → Ids) : Block → Block := fun x =>
73 Block.each ids (Stm.assign "d" (.bin .div (.var "d") (.lit 2)))
74 (Block.commit bd
75 (Block.each ids
76 (Stm.ite (.bin .lt (.var "tid") (.var "d"))
77 (Stm.store "s" (.var "tid")
78 (.bin .add (.load "s" (.var "tid")) (.load "s" (.bin .add (.var "tid") (.var "d")))))
79 Stm.skip)
80 (x.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.lit 0) (.var "d")))))
81
82/-- The loop invariant after `k` turns. -/
83private structure Inv (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b k : Nat) (B : Block) : Prop where
84 ok : B.ok = true
85 env : ∀ t, (B.ts t).env = envk bd args b k t
86 log : ∀ t, (B.ts t).log = []
87 tok : ∀ t < bd, (B.ts t).ok = true
88 tmem : ∀ t, (B.ts t).mem = B.mem
89 s : ∀ t : Int, 0 ≤ t → t < wk bd k → B.mem "s" t = S bd args M0 b k t
90 other : ∀ a, a ≠ "s" → ∀ i, B.mem a i = M0 a i
91 phases : B.phases = P0 bd args M0 b :: (List.range k).map (Q bd args M0 b)
92
93/-! ### Arithmetic of the strides -/
94
95private theorem dk_succ (bd k : Nat) : dk bd k / 2 = dk bd (k + 1) := by
96 simp only [dk, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, Nat.pow_succ]
97
98private theorem wk_succ (bd k : Nat) : wk bd (k + 1) = dk bd k := rfl
99
100private theorem wk_eq {bd p k : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) (hk : k < p) : wk bd k = 2 * dk bd k := by
101 subst hbd
102 simp only [wk, dk, Nat.pow_div (Nat.le_of_lt hk) (by omega : 0 < 2),
103 Nat.pow_div hk (by omega : 0 < 2), Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
104 rw [show p - k = (p - (k + 1)) + 1 by omega, Nat.pow_succ]
105 omega
106
107private theorem dk_pos {bd p k : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) (hk : k < p) : 0 < dk bd k := by
108 subst hbd
109 exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)) (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
110
111private theorem dk_last {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) : dk bd p = 0 := by
112 subst hbd
113 exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
114
115private theorem dk_le {bd : Nat} (k : Nat) : 2 * dk bd k ≤ bd := by
116 simp only [dk, Nat.pow_succ]
117 have := Nat.div_mul_le_self bd (2 ^ k * 2)
118 have : 2 ^ k * 2 ≥ 2 := by have := Nat.two_pow_pos k; omega
119 have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (bd / (2 ^ k * 2)) this
120 omega
121
122private theorem wk_zero (bd : Nat) : wk bd 0 = bd := by simp [wk]
123
124private theorem wk_last {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) : wk bd p = 1 := by
125 subst hbd; simp [wk, Nat.div_self (Nat.two_pow_pos p)]
126
127private theorem p_le_half {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) : p ≤ bd / 2 := by
128 subst hbd
129 cases p with
130 | zero => simp
131 | succ p =>
132 rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (by omega)]
133 have := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := p)
134 omega
135
136/-! ### The partial sums -/
137
138private theorem S_zero (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat) (t : Nat) :
139 S bd args M0 b 0 t = val args M0 (gid bd b t) := by
140 simp only [S, Nat.pow_zero, Int.natCast_one, isum_one, Int.zero_mul, Int.add_zero]
141 congr 1
142
143/-- Folding the upper half in: a sum of `2^(k+1)` products is two sums of `2^k`. -/
144private theorem S_succ {bd p : Nat} (hbd : bd = 2 ^ p) {k : Nat} (hk : k < p) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem)
145 (b : Nat) (t : Int) :
146 S bd args M0 b (k + 1) t = S bd args M0 b k t + S bd args M0 b k (t + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)) := by
147 simp only [S, wk_succ]
148 rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm, isum_even_odd, wk_eq hbd hk]
149 congr 1
150 · apply isum_congr
151 intro m
152 congr 1
153 simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Int.ofNat_two]
154 ac_rfl
155 · apply isum_congr
156 intro m
157 congr 1
158 simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Int.ofNat_two]
159 rw [Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul]
160 have e : m * (2 * ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)) = 2 * m * ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int) := by ac_rfl
161 rw [e]
162 omega
163
164/-- A staged product is below 24 bits, or zero. -/
165private theorem val_bounds (args : Env) (M0 : Mem)
166 (hxy : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → -2 ^ 23 ≤ M0 "x" i * M0 "y" i ∧ M0 "x" i * M0 "y" i < 2 ^ 23)
167 (g : Int) (hg : 0 ≤ g) : -2 ^ 23 ≤ val args M0 g ∧ val args M0 g ≤ 2 ^ 23 - 1 := by
168 unfold val
169 split
170 · have := hxy g hg ‹_›
171 omega
172 · omega
173
174/-- A partial sum of `2^k` staged products. -/
175private theorem S_bounds (bd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (b : Nat)
176 (hxy : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → -2 ^ 23 ≤ M0 "x" i * M0 "y" i ∧ M0 "x" i * M0 "y" i < 2 ^ 23)
177 (k : Nat) (t : Int) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) :
178 ((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int) * (-2 ^ 23) ≤ S bd args M0 b k t ∧
179 S bd args M0 b k t ≤ ((2 ^ k : Nat) : Int) * (2 ^ 23 - 1) := by
180 apply isum_bounds
181 intro m hm0 hm
182 have := Int.mul_nonneg hm0 (Int.natCast_nonneg (wk bd k))
183 exact val_bounds args M0 hxy _ (by omega)
184
185/-! ### The invariant -/

189private theorem mem_P0 {t : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ P0 bd args M0 b t) :
190 (((gid bd b t : Nat) : Int) < args "n" ∧
191 (acc = .read "x" (gid bd b t) ∨ acc = .read "y" (gid bd b t) ∨
192 acc = .write "s" t (M0 "x" (gid bd b t) * M0 "y" (gid bd b t)))) ∨
193 (¬ ((gid bd b t : Nat) : Int) < args "n" ∧ acc = .write "s" t 0) := by

198 · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h

201/-- The two shapes a `P0` access can take, without the guard. -/
202private theorem mem_P0' {t : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ P0 bd args M0 b t) :
203 acc = .read "x" (gid bd b t) ∨ acc = .read "y" (gid bd b t) ∨ ∃ w, acc = .write "s" t w := by

208 · exact .inr (.inr ⟨_, h⟩)

210private theorem mem_Q {k t : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ Q bd args M0 b k t) :
211 (t : Int) < ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int) ∧
212 (acc = .read "s" t ∨ acc = .read "s" ((t : Int) + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)) ∨
213 acc = .write "s" t (S bd args M0 b k t + S bd args M0 b k ((t : Int) + ((dk bd k : Nat) : Int)))) := by
214 simp only [Q] at h
215 split at h
216 · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
217 exact ⟨‹_›, h⟩
218 · simp at h

220private theorem mem_Pf {p t : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ Pf bd args M0 b p t) :
221 (t : Int) = 0 ∧ (acc = .read "s" 0 ∨ acc = .atomic "out" 0 (S bd args M0 b p 0)) := by
222 simp only [Pf] at h
223 split at h

Each warp sums its 32 cells with shuffle-down into $\mathit{out}_b$.
CUDA · kernels/warp_sum.cu · 7 lines
1__global__ void warp_sum(int* out, int* src, int n) {
2 int i = blockIdx.x * 32 + threadIdx.x;
3 int v = 0;
4 if (i < n) v = src[i];
5 for (int d = 16; d > 0; d /= 2) v += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, v, d);
6 if (threadIdx.x == 0) out[blockIdx.x] = v;
7}

No data race (two threads touch a cell only if both read it or both add to it atomically); barriers are uniform; every loop terminates; no int operation overflows or divides by zero; every shared-memory access is in bounds. Every int parameter and cell is assumed to hold a 32-bit value, as its type says.
Proof · Specs/WarpSum.lean · 437 lines
1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract
2import Gellar.Kernel.Phases
3import Gellar.Kernel.Tactics
4import Generated.WarpSum
5
6namespace Specs.WarpSum
7
8open Gellar.Kernel Generated.WarpSum
9
10/-- Warp reduction: one warp per block, each lane loads one cell (zero past `n`), and five
11`__shfl_down_sync` rounds fold the warp's values into lane 0, which writes the block's sum.
12No shared memory and no barrier: the exchange is between registers. Every lane's running
13sum is a sum of at most 32 loaded values (a lane past the warp's edge adds its own value
14again), so loaded values of at most 26 bits keep the sums in `int`. -/
15contract warp_sum (out : int*) (src : int*) (n : int) where
16 requires blockDim = 32
17 requires gridDim * 32 ≤ 2^31
18 requires -2^26 ≤ src[i] ∧ src[i] < 2^26 when 0 ≤ i < n
19 ensures out[b] = sum j < 32, (if b * 32 + j < n then src[b * 32 + j] else 0) when 0 ≤ b < gridDim
20 ensures ∀ (i : Int), (i < 0 ∨ gridDim ≤ i) → out[i] = old(out[i])
21 unchanged src
22
23/-! ## Proof
24
25After `k` rounds the stride is `dk k = 32 / 2^(k+1)` and lane `t < wk k = 32 / 2^k` holds the sum
26of `2^k` loaded values `wk k` apart (`V k t`), exactly as in the shared-memory tree reduction,
27except that the exchange is `Block.shfl` and nothing is committed until the end. -/
28
29private def dk (k : Nat) : Nat := 32 / 2 ^ (k + 1)
30private def wk (k : Nat) : Nat := 32 / 2 ^ k
31
32variable (gd : Nat) (args : Env) (M0 : Mem) (FA : FEnv) (FM0 : FMem) (b : Nat)
33
34/-- The value lane `j` loads. -/
35private def s (j : Int) : Int :=
36 if (b : Int) * 32 + j < args "n" then M0 "src" ((b : Int) * 32 + j) else 0
37
38/-- The partial sum in lane `t` after `k` rounds. -/
39private def V (k t : Nat) : Int :=
40 isum 0 (2 ^ k : Nat) fun m => s args M0 b (t + m * ((wk k : Nat) : Int))
41
42/-- The reads of lane `t`: its one load. -/
43private abbrev L0 : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
44 if ((b : Int) * 32 + t) < args "n" then [.read "src" ((b : Int) * 32 + t)] else []
45
46/-- The only phase: the loads, and lane 0's write. -/
47private abbrev Pf : Nat → List Access := fun t =>
48 if (t : Int) = 0 then L0 args b t ++ [.write "out" b (V args M0 b 5 0)] else L0 args b t
49
50/-- One round, as the lockstep semantics runs it. -/
51private abbrev F (ids : Nat → Ids) : Block → Block := fun x =>
52 Block.each ids (Stm.assign "d" (.bin .div (.var "d") (.lit 2)))
53 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "v" (.bin .add (.var "v") (.var "__shfl0")))
54 (Block.shfl 32 ids "__shfl0" (.var "v") (.var "d")
55 (x.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.lit 0) (.var "d")))))
56
57/-- The invariant after `k` rounds. -/
58private structure Inv (k : Nat) (B : Block) : Prop where
59 ok : B.ok = true
60 d : ∀ t, (B.ts t).env "d" = ((dk k : Nat) : Int)
61 v : ∀ t < wk k, (B.ts t).env "v" = V args M0 b k t
62 log : ∀ t, (B.ts t).log = L0 args b t
63 tok : ∀ t < 32, (B.ts t).ok = true
64 tmem : ∀ t, (B.ts t).mem = M0
65 mem : B.mem = M0
66 phases : B.phases = []
67 /-- Every lane's running sum is a sum of `2^k` loaded values. -/
68 vb : ∀ t < 32, -(2 ^ 26) * (2 : Int) ^ k ≤ (B.ts t).env "v" ∧
69 (B.ts t).env "v" ≤ (2 ^ 26 - 1) * (2 : Int) ^ k
70
71/-! ### Arithmetic of the strides (`32 = 2^5`) -/
72
73private theorem dk_succ (k : Nat) : dk k / 2 = dk (k + 1) := by
74 simp only [dk, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, Nat.pow_succ]
75
76private theorem wk_succ (k : Nat) : wk (k + 1) = dk k := rfl
77
78private theorem wk_eq {k : Nat} (hk : k < 5) : wk k = 2 * dk k := by
79 simp only [wk, dk, show (32 : Nat) = 2 ^ 5 from rfl, Nat.pow_div (Nat.le_of_lt hk) (by omega : 0 < 2),
80 Nat.pow_div hk (by omega : 0 < 2), Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
81 rw [show 5 - k = (5 - (k + 1)) + 1 by omega, Nat.pow_succ]
82 omega
83
84private theorem dk_pos {k : Nat} (hk : k < 5) : 0 < dk k := by
85 simp only [dk]
86 rw [show (32 : Nat) = 2 ^ 5 from rfl]
87 exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)) (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
88
89private theorem dk_last : dk 5 = 0 := by decide
90
91private theorem dk_le (k : Nat) : 2 * dk k ≤ 32 := by
92 simp only [dk, Nat.pow_succ]
93 have := Nat.div_mul_le_self 32 (2 ^ k * 2)
94 have : 2 ^ k * 2 ≥ 2 := by have := Nat.two_pow_pos k; omega
95 have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (32 / (2 ^ k * 2)) this
96 omega
97
98private theorem wk_zero : wk 0 = 32 := by decide
99private theorem wk_last : wk 5 = 1 := by decide
100private theorem dk_zero : dk 0 = 16 := by decide
101
102/-! ### The partial sums -/
103
104/-- A loaded value is below 26 bits, or zero. -/
105private theorem s_bounds (hsrc : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → -2 ^ 26 ≤ M0 "src" i ∧ M0 "src" i < 2 ^ 26)
106 (j : Int) (hj : 0 ≤ j) : -(2 ^ 26) ≤ s args M0 b j ∧ s args M0 b j ≤ 2 ^ 26 - 1 := by
107 unfold s
108 split
109 · have := hsrc ((b : Int) * 32 + j) (by omega) ‹_›
110 omega
111 · omega
112
113private theorem V_zero (t : Nat) : V args M0 b 0 t = s args M0 b t := by
114 simp only [V, Nat.pow_zero, Int.natCast_one, isum_one, Int.zero_mul, Int.add_zero]
115
116/-- Folding the upper half in. -/
117private theorem V_succ {k : Nat} (hk : k < 5) (t : Nat) :
118 V args M0 b (k + 1) t = V args M0 b k t + V args M0 b k (t + dk k) := by
119 simp only [V, wk_succ]
120 rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm, isum_even_odd, wk_eq hk]
121 congr 1
122 · apply isum_congr
123 intro m
124 congr 1
125 simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Int.ofNat_two]
126 ac_rfl
127 · apply isum_congr
128 intro m
129 congr 1
130 simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Int.ofNat_two, Int.natCast_add]
131 rw [Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul]
132 have e : m * (2 * ((dk k : Nat) : Int)) = 2 * m * ((dk k : Nat) : Int) := by ac_rfl
133 rw [e]
134 omega
135
136/-- The whole warp's sum, as the contract states it. -/
137private theorem V_last :
138 V args M0 b 5 0 = isum 0 32 fun j => if (b : Int) * 32 + j < args "n" then M0 "src" ((b : Int) * 32 + j) else 0 := by
139 simp only [V, wk_last, Int.natCast_one, Int.mul_one, Int.natCast_zero, Int.zero_add, s]
140 rfl
141
142/-! ### The invariant -/
143
144private theorem mem_L0 {t : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ L0 args b t) :
145 ((b : Int) * 32 + t) < args "n" ∧ acc = .read "src" ((b : Int) * 32 + t) := by
146 simp only [L0] at h
147 split at h
148 · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h
149 exact ⟨‹_›, h⟩
150 · simp at h
151
152private theorem mem_Pf {t : Nat} {acc : Access} (h : acc ∈ Pf args M0 b t) :
153 (∃ j : Nat, j = t ∧ ((b : Int) * 32 + j) < args "n" ∧ acc = .read "src" ((b : Int) * 32 + j)) ∨
154 ((t : Int) = 0 ∧ acc = .write "out" b (V args M0 b 5 0)) := by
155 simp only [Pf] at h
156 split at h
157 · rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at h
158 rcases h with h | h
159 · exact .inl ⟨t, rfl, mem_L0 args b h⟩
160 · exact .inr ⟨‹_›, h⟩
161 · exact .inl ⟨t, rfl, mem_L0 args b h⟩
