164private theorem inv_entry (ids : Nat → Ids) (hids : ∀ t, ids t = launchIds gd 32 b t) (hb : b < gd)
165 (hg32 : gd * 32 ≤ 2 ^ 31)
166 (hsrc : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < args "n" → -2 ^ 26 ≤ M0 "src" i ∧ M0 "src" i < 2 ^ 26) :
167 Inv args M0 b 0
168 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "d" (.lit 16))
169 (Block.each ids (Stm.ite (.bin .lt (.var "i") (.var "n")) (Stm.assign "v" (.load "src" (.var "i"))) .skip)
170 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "v" (.lit 0))
171 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "i" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.blockIdx .x) (.lit 32)) (.threadIdx .x)))
172 ⟨M0, FM0, fun _ => ⟨args, M0, FA, FM0, [], true⟩, [], true⟩)))) := by
173 have hv : ∀ t, ((Block.each ids (Stm.assign "d" (.lit 16))
174 (Block.each ids (Stm.ite (.bin .lt (.var "i") (.var "n")) (Stm.assign "v" (.load "src" (.var "i"))) .skip)
175 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "v" (.lit 0))
176 (Block.each ids (Stm.assign "i" (.bin .add (.bin .mul (.blockIdx .x) (.lit 32)) (.threadIdx .x)))
177 ⟨M0, FM0, fun _ => ⟨args, M0, FA, FM0, [], true⟩, [], true⟩)))).ts t).env "v" = s args M0 b t := by
178 intro t
179 simp only [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, Stm.exec_ite, Stm.exec_skip,
180 TState.reads, TState.env_ite, Exp.eval, BinOp.eval, hids, launchIds_tid, launchIds_bid, Dim3.get_x,
181 String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, Int.one_ne_zero, imp_false,
182 Decidable.not_not, s]
183 split <;> simp
184 refine ⟨rfl, fun t => ?_, fun t ht => ?_, fun t => ?_, fun t ht => ?_, fun t => ?_, rfl, rfl, fun t ht => ?_⟩
185 · simp [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, Stm.exec_ite, TState.reads, Exp.eval,
186 BinOp.eval, dk_zero, TState.env_ite]
187 · rw [hv, V_zero]
188 · simp only [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, Stm.exec_ite, Stm.exec_skip,
189 TState.reads, TState.log_ite, Exp.eval, Exp.reads, BinOp.eval, BinOp.evalsRight, hids, launchIds_tid,
190 launchIds_bid, Dim3.get_x, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, Int.one_ne_zero,
191 imp_false, Decidable.not_not, List.map, List.append_nil, List.nil_append, ite_self, L0]
192 · -- The lane's index `b * 32 + t` fits.
193 simp only [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, Stm.exec_ite, Stm.exec_skip, TState.reads, TState.ok_ite,
194 Exp.eval, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits, BinOp.evalsRight, BinOp.eval, hids, launchIds_tid, launchIds_bid,
195 Dim3.get_x, Bool.and_true, Bool.true_and, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, ite_self, Bool.and_eq_true,
196 int32b_eq_true]
197 fits
198 · simp only [Block.each_ts]
199 rw [Stm.exec_mem_of_noStore _ _ rfl, Stm.exec_mem_of_noStore _ _ rfl,
200 Stm.exec_mem_of_noStore _ _ rfl, Stm.exec_mem_of_noStore _ _ rfl]
201 · rw [hv]

206/-- One round keeps the invariant. -/
207private theorem inv_step (ids : Nat → Ids) {k : Nat} (hk : k < 5) {B : Block} (h : Inv args M0 b k B) :
208 Inv args M0 b (k + 1) (F ids B) := by
209 have hdk : ((dk k : Nat) : Int).toNat = dk k := Int.toNat_natCast _
210 have hshfl : ∀ t, ((Block.shfl 32 ids "__shfl0" (.var "v") (.var "d")
211 (B.readAll ids (.bin .lt (.lit 0) (.var "d")))).ts t) =
212 ⟨fun y => if y = "__shfl0" then
213 (B.ts (if t % 32 + dk k < 32 then t + dk k else t)).env "v" else (B.ts t).env y,
214 M0, (B.ts t).fenv, (B.ts t).fmem, L0 args b t,
215 (B.ts t).ok && decide ((if t % 32 + dk k < 32 then t + dk k else t) < 32)⟩ := by
216 intro t
217 rw [Block.shfl_ts]
218 simp only [Block.readAll_ts_env, Block.readAll_ts_mem, Block.readAll_ts_fenv, Block.readAll_ts_fmem,
219 Block.readAll_ts_log, Block.readAll_ts_ok, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits, BinOp.evalsRight, Bool.and_true,
220 Bool.true_and, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, ite_self, ↓reduceIte, List.map_nil, List.nil_append,
221 Exp.eval, Exp.reads, List.map, List.append_nil, h.d, h.log, h.tmem, hdk, warpSize]
222 -- The source lane of lane `t`, and the bounds on both running sums.
223 have hsrc_lt : ∀ t < 32, (if t % 32 + dk k < 32 then t + dk k else t) < 32 := by
224 intro t ht; split <;> omega
225 have hvsum : ∀ t < 32, -(2 ^ 26) * (2 : Int) ^ (k + 1) ≤
226 (B.ts t).env "v" + (B.ts (if t % 32 + dk k < 32 then t + dk k else t)).env "v" ∧
227 (B.ts t).env "v" + (B.ts (if t % 32 + dk k < 32 then t + dk k else t)).env "v" ≤
228 (2 ^ 26 - 1) * (2 : Int) ^ (k + 1) := by
229 intro t ht
230 have h1 := h.vb t ht
231 have h2 := h.vb _ (hsrc_lt t ht)
232 have hpow : (2 : Int) ^ (k + 1) = 2 ^ k * 2 := Int.pow_succ ..
233 generalize (2 : Int) ^ k = w at h1 h2 hpow
234 rw [hpow]
235 constructor <;> omega
236 refine ⟨h.ok, fun t => ?_, fun t ht => ?_, fun t => ?_, fun t ht => ?_, fun t => ?_, h.mem, h.phases,
237 fun t ht => ?_⟩
238 · simp only [F, Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval, BinOp.eval, hshfl,
239 String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
240 rw [h.d, ← dk_succ, Int.ofNat_tdiv]
241 rfl
242 · simp only [F, Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval, BinOp.eval, hshfl,
243 String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
244 rw [wk_succ] at ht
245 have hw := wk_eq hk
246 have hmod : t % 32 = t := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by have := dk_le k; omega)
247 rw [hmod, if_pos (by have := dk_le k; omega), h.v t (by omega), h.v (t + dk k) (by omega), V_succ args M0 b hk]
248 · simp [F, Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.reads, hshfl]
249 · -- No lane fails: its source lane exists, the sum fits, and so does `d / 2`.
250 simp only [F, Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval, Exp.fits, BinOp.fits,
251 BinOp.evalsRight, BinOp.eval, hshfl, h.tok t ht, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_true, Bool.not_true,
252 Bool.false_or, String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, int32b_eq_true,
253 h.d]
254 have hs := hsrc_lt t ht
255 have hv := hvsum t ht
256 have htd := int32_natCast_tdiv (dk k) 2 (by have := dk_le k; omega)
257 have h2k' : (2 : Int) ^ (k + 1) ≤ 32 := by
258 have : 2 ^ (k + 1) ≤ 2 ^ 5 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
259 exact_mod_cast this
260 generalize (2 : Int) ^ (k + 1) = w at *
261 refine ⟨⟨hs, ?_⟩, rfl, htd⟩
262 unfold int32
263 omega
264 · simp [F, Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, hshfl]
265 · -- The new running sum is bounded by `2^(k+1)` loaded values.
266 simp only [F, Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, TState.reads, Exp.eval, BinOp.eval, hshfl,
267 String.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
268 exact hvsum t ht

270/-- The invariant after `k ≤ 5` rounds. -/
271private theorem inv_iter (ids : Nat → Ids) {B : Block} (h0 : Inv args M0 b 0 B) :
272 ∀ k ≤ 5, Inv args M0 b k (iter (F ids) k B) := by
273 intro k
274 induction k with
275 | zero => intro _; exact h0
276 | succ k ih =>
277 intro hk
278 rw [iter_succ_apply]
279 exact inv_step args M0 b ids (by omega) (ih (by omega))

282private theorem cond_uniform (ids : Nat → Ids) {k : Nat} {B : Block} (h : Inv args M0 b k B) :
283 B.uniform 32 ids (.bin .lt (.lit 0) (.var "d")) = some (if 0 < ((dk k : Nat) : Int) then 1 else 0) := by
284 apply Block.uniform_of_const

291private theorem block_shape (hb : b < gd) (hg32 : gd * 32 ≤ 2 ^ 31)

293 (hM0 : warp_sum.mem0 mem sh b = M0) :

302 rw [Block.uniform_of_const _ _ _ _ 16 (by
303 intro t
304 simp only [Block.each_ts, Stm.exec_assign, Stm.exec_ite, TState.reads, Exp.eval, BinOp.eval,

313 (Block.shfl 32 (launchIds gd 32 b) "__shfl0" (.var "v") (.var "d")
314 (Block.readAll (launchIds gd 32 b) (.bin .lt (.lit 0) (.var "d")) x)))) =

Warp 0 writes $\mathit{data}_i$ and release-stores $\mathit{flag}_i$; warp 1 spins on $\mathit{flag}_i$ with acquire loads, then $\mathit{out}_i = \mathit{data}_i$.
CUDA · kernels/publish.cu · 12 lines
1__global__ void publish(int* out, int* data, int* flag, int* src) {
2 int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
3 if (threadIdx.x < 32) {
4 data[lane] = src[lane];
5 cuda::atomic_ref<int, cuda::thread_scope_block> f(flag[lane]);
6 f.store(1, cuda::memory_order_release);
7 } else {
8 cuda::atomic_ref<int, cuda::thread_scope_block> f(flag[lane]);
9 while (f.load(cuda::memory_order_acquire) == 0) {}
10 out[lane] = data[lane];
11 }
12}

Proved on the PTX machine (the memory consistency model of the PTX ISA, Gellar/Machine/): every consistent, data-race-free execution of the launch ends in a memory meeting the clauses above, and such an execution exists. The kernel synchronises its threads itself, through cuda::atomic_ref, so the lockstep model's race check does not apply. Every int parameter and cell is assumed to hold a 32-bit value, as its type says.

1import Gellar.Kernel.Contract

7open Gellar.Kernel Gellar.Machine Generated.Publish
8
9/-- One-shot publication between two warps of one block, lane to lane, through a release/acquire
10flag and no `__syncthreads`: the primitive of warp specialisation. Each lane of warp 0 writes
11its cell of `data` and then sets its flag with a `cuda::atomic_ref` store at block scope and
12release order; the same lane of warp 1 spins on the flag with acquire loads and, once it sees
13it set, copies the cell to `out`. The lockstep model cannot run this kernel (a thread reads a
14flag another thread sets inside the one phase), so the contract is about the PTX machine: the
15acquire load that ends the spin reads the release store, which synchronizes the two lanes, and
16the Causality axiom then makes the consumer's load of `data` read the producer's store. -/
17contract publish (out : int*) (data : int*) (flag : int*) (src : int*) where
18 physical
19 requires gridDim = 1
20 requires blockDim = 64
21 requires flag[i] = 0 when 0 ≤ i < 32
22 ensures out[i] = src[i] when 0 ≤ i < 32
23 ensures out[i] = old(out[i]) otherwise
24 ensures data[i] = src[i] when 0 ≤ i < 32
25 ensures data[i] = old(data[i]) otherwise
26 ensures flag[i] = 1 when 0 ≤ i < 32
27 ensures flag[i] = old(flag[i]) otherwise
28 unchanged src
29
30/-! ## The events of the kernel -/
31
32/-- A global cell. -/
33abbrev gl (a : String) (i : Int) : Loc := ⟨.global, a, i⟩
34
35abbrev ldSrc (i u : Int) : Event := .load .weak .sys (gl "src" i) (.int u)
36abbrev stData (i u : Int) : Event := .store .weak .sys (gl "data" i) (.int u)
37abbrev stFlag (i : Int) : Event := .store .release .cta (gl "flag" i) (.int 1)
38abbrev ldFlag (i v : Int) : Event := .load .acquire .cta (gl "flag" i) (.int v)
39abbrev ldData (i w : Int) : Event := .load .weak .sys (gl "data" i) (.int w)
40abbrev stOut (i w : Int) : Event := .store .weak .sys (gl "out" i) (.int w)
41
42/-- Thread `i` of the one block. -/
43abbrev T (i : Nat) : Tid := ⟨0, i⟩
44
45theorem T_inj {i j : Nat} (h : T i = T j) : i = j := by cases h; rfl
46
47/-- The body, as the sequence of statements the translator produced. -/
48abbrev bodySeq : Stm :=
49 .seq (.assign "lane" (.bin .mod (.threadIdx .x) (.lit 32)))
50 (.ite (.bin .lt (.threadIdx .x) (.lit 32))
51 (.seq (.store "data" (.var "lane") (.load "src" (.var "lane")))
52 (.seq (.assign "__ref0" (.var "lane")) (.astore .release .block "flag" (.var "__ref0") (.lit 1))))
53 (.seq (.assign "__ref1" (.var "lane"))
54 (.seq (.seq (.aload "__aload0" .acquire .block "flag" (.var "__ref1"))
55 (.loop (.lit 0) (.bin .eq (.var "__aload0") (.lit 0))
56 (.seq .skip (.aload "__aload0" .acquire .block "flag" (.var "__ref1")))))
57 (.store "out" (.var "lane") (.load "data" (.var "lane"))))))

66 show wrap32 ((i : Int).tmod 32) = i

72 show wrap32 ((i : Int).tmod 32) = _

80 show wrap32 ((32 + (i : Int)).tmod 32) = _

82 have : (32 + (i : Int)) % 32 = i := by omega
83 rw [this]
84 exact wrap32_of_int32 ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

251 w : Int

261 (∀ i : Int, (i < 0 ∨ 32 ≤ i) → m "out" i = mem "out" i ∧ m "data" i = mem "data" i ∧ m "flag" i = mem "flag" i) ∧
262 (∀ i : Int, m "src" i = mem "src" i) := by

264 have hgd := hcand.gd_eq
265 have hbd := hcand.bd_eq

283 hwf.tr_launch t (by rw [hgd, hbd]; exact h)

287 (x.1 = T (32 + i) ∧ (ev ∈ (C i).ws ∨ ev = ldData i (C i).w ∨ ev = stOut i (C i).w))) := by

299 simpa using hmem
300 · refine ⟨t - 32, by omega, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
301 · show (⟨0, t⟩ : Tid) = ⟨0, 32 + (t - 32)⟩
302 congr 1; omega
303 · have h2 := (hC (t - 32) (by omega)).2.1
304 rw [show 32 + (t - 32) = t by omega] at h2
305 rw [h2] at hmem
306 simpa using hmem
307 -- every write, by position
308 have hW : ∀ w L, e.valid w → e.has Event.isWrite w → e.loc? w = some L →
309 (∃ i, i < 32 ∧ w = (T i, 1) ∧ L = gl "data" i ∧ e.writeVal? w = some (.int (U i))) ∨
310 (∃ i, i < 32 ∧ w = (T i, 2) ∧ L = gl "flag" i ∧ e.writeVal? w = some (.int 1)) ∨
311 (∃ i, i < 32 ∧ w = (T (32 + i), (C i).ws.length + 1) ∧ L = gl "out" i ∧ e.writeVal? w = some (.int (C i).w)) := by
312 intro w L hv hw hL
313 obtain ⟨ev, hev'⟩ := e.ev?_some_iff.2 hv.2.2
314 have hw' : ev.isWrite = true := by rw [e.has_of_ev? hev'] at hw; exact hw
315 have hL' : ev.loc? = some L := by rw [e.loc?_eq hev'] at hL; exact hL
316 rw [e.writeVal?_eq hev']
317 have hpos := e.ev?_eq_map w
318 rw [hev'] at hpos
319 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨hx1, hev''⟩ | ⟨hx1, hev''⟩⟩ := hev w ev hev'
320 · rw [hx1, (hU i hi).2] at hpos
321 rcases idx_of_three hpos.symm with ⟨hj, rfl⟩ | ⟨hj, rfl⟩ | ⟨hj, rfl⟩
322 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw'
323 · left
324 refine ⟨i, hi, Prod.ext hx1 hj, ?_, rfl⟩
325 simp [Event.loc?] at hL'; exact hL'.symm
326 · right; left
327 refine ⟨i, hi, Prod.ext hx1 hj, ?_, rfl⟩
328 simp [Event.loc?] at hL'; exact hL'.symm
329 · rw [hx1, (hC i hi).2.1] at hpos
330 rcases idx_of_append_two hpos.symm with ⟨-, hmem⟩ | ⟨hj, rfl⟩ | ⟨hj, rfl⟩
331 · obtain ⟨v', rfl⟩ := (hC i hi).2.2.1 ev hmem
332 simp [Event.isWrite] at hw'
333 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw'
334 · right; right
335 refine ⟨i, hi, Prod.ext hx1 hj, ?_, rfl⟩
336 simp [Event.loc?] at hL'; exact hL'.symm
337 -- the lanes' events, and what each lane reads
338 have hlane : ∀ i, i < 32 → (C i).w = mem "src" i ∧ U i = mem "src" i ∧
339 e.valid (T i, 1) ∧ e.ev? (T i, 1) = some (stData i (U i)) ∧
340 e.valid (T i, 2) ∧ e.ev? (T i, 2) = some (stFlag i) ∧
341 e.valid (T (32 + i), (C i).ws.length + 1) ∧
342 e.ev? (T (32 + i), (C i).ws.length + 1) = some (stOut i (C i).w) := by
343 intro i hi
344 obtain ⟨hU32, hUtr⟩ := hU i hi
345 obtain ⟨hCw, hCtr, hCws, hCv, hCv0⟩ := hC i hi
346 have hlenP : (e.tr (T i)).length = 3 := by rw [← List.length_map Ev.ev, hUtr]; rfl
347 have hlenC : (e.tr (T (32 + i))).length = (C i).ws.length + 2 := by
348 rw [← List.length_map Ev.ev, hCtr]; simp
349 have hvP : ∀ j, j < 3 → e.valid (T i, j) := fun j hj =>
350 ⟨by rw [hgd]; exact Nat.one_pos, by rw [hbd]; show i < 64; omega, by rw [hlenP]; exact hj⟩
351 have hvC : ∀ j, j < (C i).ws.length + 2 → e.valid (T (32 + i), j) := fun j hj =>
352 ⟨by rw [hgd]; exact Nat.one_pos, by rw [hbd]; show 32 + i < 64; omega, by rw [hlenC]; exact hj⟩
353 have hev0 : e.ev? (T i, 0) = some (ldSrc i (U i)) := by rw [e.ev?_eq_map]; show ((e.tr (T i)).map Ev.ev)[0]? = _; rw [hUtr]; rfl
354 have hev1 : e.ev? (T i, 1) = some (stData i (U i)) := by rw [e.ev?_eq_map]; show ((e.tr (T i)).map Ev.ev)[1]? = _; rw [hUtr]; rfl
355 have hev2 : e.ev? (T i, 2) = some (stFlag i) := by rw [e.ev?_eq_map]; show ((e.tr (T i)).map Ev.ev)[2]? = _; rw [hUtr]; rfl
356 obtain ⟨p, hp, hpv⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hCv
357 have hevp : e.ev? (T (32 + i), p) = some (ldFlag i (C i).v) := by
358 rw [e.ev?_eq_map]; show ((e.tr (T (32 + i))).map Ev.ev)[p]? = _
359 rw [hCtr, List.getElem?_append_left hp, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hp, hpv]
360 have hevd : e.ev? (T (32 + i), (C i).ws.length) = some (ldData i (C i).w) := by
361 rw [e.ev?_eq_map]; show ((e.tr (T (32 + i))).map Ev.ev)[(C i).ws.length]? = _
362 rw [hCtr, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _), Nat.sub_self]; rfl
363 have hevo : e.ev? (T (32 + i), (C i).ws.length + 1) = some (stOut i (C i).w) := by
364 rw [e.ev?_eq_map]; show ((e.tr (T (32 + i))).map Ev.ev)[(C i).ws.length + 1]? = _
365 rw [hCtr, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]; rfl
366 -- the acquire load that ended the spin reads the release store
367 have hrfp : e.rf (T (32 + i), p) = some (T i, 2) := by
368 rcases e.read_source hwf (hvC p (by omega)) (by rw [e.has_of_ev? hevp]; rfl) (e.loc?_eq hevp)
369 (by rw [e.readVal?_eq hevp]; rfl) with ⟨-, h0⟩ | ⟨w, hrf, hvw, hww, hLw, -⟩
370 · exfalso
371 apply hCv0
372 rw [h0, hinit]
373 exact hflag i (by omega) (by omega)
374 · rcases hW w _ hvw hww hLw with ⟨j, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨j, -, rfl, hL, -⟩ | ⟨j, -, -, hL, -⟩
375 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
376 · have : j = i := by have := (gl_inj hL).2; omega
377 subst this; exact hrf
378 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
379 -- so the producer's store of `data` is causally before the consumer's load of it
380 have hcb : e.causeBase (T i, 1) (T (32 + i), (C i).ws.length) :=
381 TC.step (Or.inl (e.po_of_lt (by omega) (hvP 2 (by omega))))
382 (TC.step (Or.inr (Or.inl (e.syncRA_of_release_acquire (by simp [T]) (hvP 2 (by omega)) (hvC p (by omega)) rfl
383 hev2 hevp hrfp)))
384 (TC.base (Or.inl (e.po_of_lt hp (hvC _ (by omega))))))
385 -- and the load reads it
386 have hdata : (C i).w = U i := by
387 have hnofr := hc.causality.2 (T i, 1) (T (32 + i), (C i).ws.length) (by rw [e.has_of_ev? hev1]; rfl)
388 (by rw [e.has_of_ev? hevd]; rfl) ⟨gl "data" i, e.loc?_eq hev1, e.loc?_eq hevd⟩ (Or.inl hcb)
389 rcases e.read_source hwf (hvC _ (by omega)) (by rw [e.has_of_ev? hevd]; rfl) (e.loc?_eq hevd)
390 (by rw [e.readVal?_eq hevd]; rfl) with ⟨hnone, -⟩ | ⟨w, -, hvw, hww, hLw, hval⟩
391 · exfalso
392 apply hnofr
393 refine ⟨by rw [e.has_of_ev? hevd]; rfl, by rw [e.has_of_ev? hev1]; rfl, hvP 1 (by omega),
394 ⟨gl "data" i, e.loc?_eq hevd, e.loc?_eq hev1⟩, ?_⟩
395 rw [hnone]; trivial
396 · rcases hW w _ hvw hww hLw with ⟨j, -, rfl, hL, hwv⟩ | ⟨j, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨j, -, -, hL, -⟩
397 · have : j = i := by have := (gl_inj hL).2; omega
398 subst this
399 rw [hval] at hwv
400 exact Val.int.inj (Option.some.inj hwv)
401 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
402 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
403 -- the producer's load of `src` reads the initial value: nothing writes `src`
404 have hsrc : U i = mem "src" i := by
405 rcases e.read_source hwf (hvP 0 (by omega)) (by rw [e.has_of_ev? hev0]; rfl) (e.loc?_eq hev0)
406 (by rw [e.readVal?_eq hev0]; rfl) with ⟨-, h0⟩ | ⟨w, -, hvw, hww, hLw, -⟩
407 · rw [h0, hinit]
408 · exfalso
409 rcases hW w _ hvw hww hLw with ⟨j, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨j, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨j, -, -, hL, -⟩ <;>
410 exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
411 exact ⟨hdata.trans hsrc, hsrc, hvP 1 (by omega), hev1, hvP 2 (by omega), hev2, hvC _ (by omega), hevo⟩
412 -- where the writes are, as a cell sees them
413 have hcell : ∀ w L, e.valid w → e.loc? w = some L → (∃ n, e.writeVal? w = some (.int n)) →
414 ∃ i : Nat, i < 32 ∧ (L = gl "data" i ∨ L = gl "flag" i ∨ L = gl "out" i) := by
415 intro w L hv hL ⟨n, hn⟩
416 rcases hW w L hv (e.has_isWrite_of_writeVal? hn) hL with ⟨i, hi, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨i, hi, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨i, hi, -, hL, -⟩
417 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inl hL⟩
418 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inl hL)⟩
419 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inr hL)⟩
420 refine ⟨fun i h0 hi => ?_, fun i hi => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
421 · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j : Nat, (j : Int) = i := ⟨i.toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0⟩
422 have hj : j < 32 := by omega
423 obtain ⟨hw, hu, hv1, hev1, hv2, hev2, hvo, hevo⟩ := hlane j hj
424 refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
425 · rw [← hw]
426 refine e.finalInt_unique (hfin "out" j).1 hvo (e.loc?_eq hevo) (by rw [e.writeVal?_eq hevo]; rfl) ?_
427 intro w' hv' hL' ⟨n, hn⟩
428 rcases hW w' _ hv' (e.has_isWrite_of_writeVal? hn) hL' with ⟨k, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨k, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨k, -, rfl, hL, -⟩
429 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
430 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
431 · have : k = j := by have := (gl_inj hL).2; omega
432 subst this; rfl
433 · rw [← hu]
434 refine e.finalInt_unique (hfin "data" j).1 hv1 (e.loc?_eq hev1) (by rw [e.writeVal?_eq hev1]; rfl) ?_
435 intro w' hv' hL' ⟨n, hn⟩
436 rcases hW w' _ hv' (e.has_isWrite_of_writeVal? hn) hL' with ⟨k, -, rfl, hL, -⟩ | ⟨k, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨k, -, -, hL, -⟩
437 · have : k = j := by have := (gl_inj hL).2; omega
438 subst this; rfl
439 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
440 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
441 · refine e.finalInt_unique (hfin "flag" j).1 hv2 (e.loc?_eq hev2) (by rw [e.writeVal?_eq hev2]; rfl) ?_
442 intro w' hv' hL' ⟨n, hn⟩
443 rcases hW w' _ hv' (e.has_isWrite_of_writeVal? hn) hL' with ⟨k, -, -, hL, -⟩ | ⟨k, -, rfl, hL, -⟩ | ⟨k, -, -, hL, -⟩
444 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
445 · have : k = j := by have := (gl_inj hL).2; omega
446 subst this; rfl
447 · exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
448 · have hout : ∀ a, a = "out" ∨ a = "data" ∨ a = "flag" → m a i = mem a i := by
449 intro a ha
450 rw [← hinit a i]
451 refine e.finalInt_none (hfin a i).1 ?_
452 intro w hv hL n hn
453 obtain ⟨k, hk, hL'⟩ := hcell w _ hv hL ⟨n, hn⟩
454 rcases hL' with hL' | hL' | hL' <;> have := (gl_inj hL').2 <;> omega
455 exact ⟨hout _ (Or.inl rfl), hout _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)), hout _ (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))⟩
456 · rw [← hinit "src" i]
457 refine e.finalInt_none (hfin "src" i).1 ?_
458 intro w hv hL n hn
459 obtain ⟨k, -, hL'⟩ := hcell w _ hv hL ⟨n, hn⟩
460 rcases hL' with hL' | hL' | hL' <;> exact absurd (gl_inj hL').1 (by decide)
461
462end Sound
463
464/-! ## An execution exists -/
465
466section Exists
467
468variable (mem : Mem) (sh : Nat → Mem) (fl : FStore)
469
470/-- The witness traces: each lane of the first warp loads `src`, writes `data` and releases its
471flag; each lane of the second warp sees the flag set at its first look, loads `data` and writes
472`out`. -/
473def wtr (t : Tid) : List Ev :=
474 if t.blk = 0 ∧ t.thr < 32 then
475 [⟨ldSrc t.thr (mem "src" t.thr), []⟩, ⟨stData t.thr (mem "src" t.thr), [0]⟩, ⟨stFlag t.thr, []⟩]
476 else if t.blk = 0 ∧ t.thr < 64 then
477 [⟨ldFlag ((t.thr - 32 : Nat) : Int) 1, []⟩,
478 ⟨ldData ((t.thr - 32 : Nat) : Int) (mem "src" ((t.thr - 32 : Nat) : Int)), [0]⟩,
479 ⟨stOut ((t.thr - 32 : Nat) : Int) (mem "src" ((t.thr - 32 : Nat) : Int)), [1, 0]⟩]
480 else []
481
482/-- The witness reads-from: the acquire load reads its lane's release store, the load of `data`
483its lane's store; the load of `src` reads the initial value. -/
484def wrf (x : EId) : Option EId :=
485 if x.1.blk = 0 ∧ 32 ≤ x.1.thr ∧ x.1.thr < 64 then
486 if x.2 = 0 then some (T (x.1.thr - 32), 2) else if x.2 = 1 then some (T (x.1.thr - 32), 1) else none
487 else none
488
489/-- The witness execution: no `co` (each cell is written once) and no `sc`. -/
490def witness : Exec := ⟨1, 64, wtr mem, initOf mem sh, finitOf fl, wrf, fun _ _ => False, fun _ _ => False⟩
491
492/-- The rank: the first warp's events, then the second's. -/
493def wrank (x : EId) : Nat := (if x.1.thr < 32 then 0 else 3) + x.2
494
495theorem wtr_launch {t : Tid} (h : ¬ (t.blk = 0 ∧ t.thr < 64)) : wtr mem t = [] := by
496 unfold wtr
497 rw [if_neg (fun h' => h ⟨h'.1, by omega⟩), if_neg h]
498
499theorem wtr_len {t : Tid} (h : t.blk = 0 ∧ t.thr < 64) : (wtr mem t).length = 3 := by
500 unfold wtr
501 by_cases h1 : t.blk = 0 ∧ t.thr < 32
502 · rw [if_pos h1]; rfl
503 · rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h]; rfl
504
505/-- Every event of the witness, by thread and position. -/
506theorem wev {x : EId} {ev : Event} (h : (witness mem sh fl).ev? x = some ev) :
507 ∃ i, i < 32 ∧
508 ((x.1 = T i ∧ ((x.2 = 0 ∧ ev = ldSrc i (mem "src" i)) ∨ (x.2 = 1 ∧ ev = stData i (mem "src" i)) ∨
509 (x.2 = 2 ∧ ev = stFlag i))) ∨
510 (x.1 = T (32 + i) ∧ ((x.2 = 0 ∧ ev = ldFlag i 1) ∨ (x.2 = 1 ∧ ev = ldData i (mem "src" i)) ∨
511 (x.2 = 2 ∧ ev = stOut i (mem "src" i))))) := by
512 rcases x with ⟨⟨b, t⟩, j⟩
513 rw [Exec.ev?_eq_map] at h
514 dsimp only at h ⊢
515 change ((wtr mem ⟨b, t⟩).map Ev.ev)[j]? = some ev at h
516 unfold wtr at h
517 dsimp only at h
518 by_cases h1 : b = 0 ∧ t < 32
519 · rw [if_pos h1] at h
520 obtain ⟨rfl, ht⟩ := h1
521 simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil] at h
522 refine ⟨t, ht, Or.inl ⟨rfl, ?_⟩⟩
523 rcases idx_of_three h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
524 · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
525 · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
526 · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
527 · rw [if_neg h1] at h
528 by_cases h2 : b = 0 ∧ t < 64
529 · rw [if_pos h2] at h
530 obtain ⟨rfl, ht⟩ := h2
531 have ht' : 32 ≤ t := by
532 by_cases h' : 32 ≤ t
533 · exact h'
534 · exact absurd ⟨rfl, by omega⟩ h1
535 simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil] at h
536 refine ⟨t - 32, by omega, Or.inr ⟨by show (⟨0, t⟩ : Tid) = ⟨0, 32 + (t - 32)⟩; congr 1; omega, ?_⟩⟩
537 rcases idx_of_three h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
538 · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
539 · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
540 · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
541 · rw [if_neg h2] at h
542 simp at h
543
544/-- The shape of every witness event. -/
545theorem wshape {x : EId} {ev : Event} (h : (witness mem sh fl).ev? x = some ev) :
546 ∃ i : Int, ev = ldSrc i (mem "src" i) ∨ ev = stData i (mem "src" i) ∨ ev = stFlag i ∨
547 ev = ldFlag i 1 ∨ ev = ldData i (mem "src" i) ∨ ev = stOut i (mem "src" i) := by
548 obtain ⟨i, -, ⟨-, ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨-, ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩⟩⟩ := wev mem sh fl h
549 · exact ⟨i, Or.inl rfl⟩
550 · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
551 · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))⟩
552 · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))⟩
553 · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))))⟩
554 · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))))⟩
555
556theorem wnot_has {p : Event → Bool} (hp : ∀ i : Int, p (ldSrc i (mem "src" i)) = false ∧ p (stData i (mem "src" i)) = false ∧
557 p (stFlag i) = false ∧ p (ldFlag i 1) = false ∧ p (ldData i (mem "src" i)) = false ∧ p (stOut i (mem "src" i)) = false)
558 (x : EId) : ¬ (witness mem sh fl).has p x := by
559 intro hx
560 unfold Exec.has at hx
561 cases hev : (witness mem sh fl).ev? x with
562 | none => rw [hev] at hx; exact hx
563 | some ev =>
564 rw [hev] at hx
565 have hx' : p ev = true := hx
566 obtain ⟨i, h⟩ := wshape mem sh fl hev
567 obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := hp i
568 rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
569
570theorem wvalid {x : EId} : (witness mem sh fl).valid x ↔ x.1.blk = 0 ∧ x.1.thr < 64 ∧ x.2 < 3 := by
571 show x.1.blk < 1 ∧ x.1.thr < 64 ∧ x.2 < (wtr mem x.1).length ↔ _
572 constructor
573 · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
574 rw [wtr_len mem ⟨by omega, h2⟩] at h3
575 exact ⟨by omega, h2, h3⟩
576 · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
577 rw [wtr_len mem ⟨h1, h2⟩]
578 exact ⟨by omega, h2, h3⟩
579
580theorem wvalid_of_ev? {x : EId} {ev : Event} (h : (witness mem sh fl).ev? x = some ev) : (witness mem sh fl).valid x := by
581 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨hx1, ⟨hx2, -⟩ | ⟨hx2, -⟩ | ⟨hx2, -⟩⟩ | ⟨hx1, ⟨hx2, -⟩ | ⟨hx2, -⟩ | ⟨hx2, -⟩⟩⟩ := wev mem sh fl h <;>
582 exact (wvalid mem sh fl).2 ⟨by rw [hx1], by rw [hx1]; simp only [T]; omega, by omega⟩
583
584/-- The six events of lane `i`. -/
585theorem wev_p0 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).ev? (T i, 0) = some (ldSrc i (mem "src" i)) := by
586 rw [Exec.ev?_eq_map]; show ((wtr mem (T i)).map Ev.ev)[0]? = _; simp [wtr, hi]
587theorem wev_p1 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).ev? (T i, 1) = some (stData i (mem "src" i)) := by
588 rw [Exec.ev?_eq_map]; show ((wtr mem (T i)).map Ev.ev)[1]? = _; simp [wtr, hi]
589theorem wev_p2 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).ev? (T i, 2) = some (stFlag i) := by
590 rw [Exec.ev?_eq_map]; show ((wtr mem (T i)).map Ev.ev)[2]? = _; simp [wtr, hi]
591theorem wev_c0 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).ev? (T (32 + i), 0) = some (ldFlag i 1) := by
592 rw [Exec.ev?_eq_map]; show ((wtr mem (T (32 + i))).map Ev.ev)[0]? = _
593 have h1 : ¬ (32 + i < 32) := by omega
594 have h2 : 32 + i < 64 := by omega
595 simp [wtr, h1, h2]
596theorem wev_c1 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).ev? (T (32 + i), 1) = some (ldData i (mem "src" i)) := by
597 rw [Exec.ev?_eq_map]; show ((wtr mem (T (32 + i))).map Ev.ev)[1]? = _
598 have h1 : ¬ (32 + i < 32) := by omega
599 have h2 : 32 + i < 64 := by omega
600 simp [wtr, h1, h2]
601theorem wev_c2 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).ev? (T (32 + i), 2) = some (stOut i (mem "src" i)) := by
602 rw [Exec.ev?_eq_map]; show ((wtr mem (T (32 + i))).map Ev.ev)[2]? = _
603 have h1 : ¬ (32 + i < 32) := by omega
604 have h2 : 32 + i < 64 := by omega
605 simp [wtr, h1, h2]
606
607theorem wvalid_p {i j : Nat} (hi : i < 32) (hj : j < 3) : (witness mem sh fl).valid (T i, j) :=
608 (wvalid mem sh fl).2 ⟨rfl, by show i < 64; omega, hj⟩
609theorem wvalid_c {i j : Nat} (hi : i < 32) (hj : j < 3) : (witness mem sh fl).valid (T (32 + i), j) :=
610 (wvalid mem sh fl).2 ⟨rfl, by show 32 + i < 64; omega, hj⟩
611
612theorem whas_valid {p : Event → Bool} {x : EId} (h : (witness mem sh fl).has p x) : (witness mem sh fl).valid x := by
613 unfold Exec.has at h
614 cases hev : (witness mem sh fl).ev? x with
615 | none => rw [hev] at h; exact h.elim
616 | some ev => exact wvalid_of_ev? mem sh fl hev
617
618/-- A write of the witness is to `data`, `flag` or `out`. -/
619theorem wwrite_arr {w : EId} {ev : Event} (hev : (witness mem sh fl).ev? w = some ev) (hw : ev.isWrite = true) :
620 ∃ a : String, a ≠ "src" ∧ ∃ j : Int, ev.loc? = some (gl a j) := by
621 obtain ⟨j, h⟩ := wshape mem sh fl hev
622 rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
623 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw
624 · exact ⟨"data", by decide, j, rfl⟩
625 · exact ⟨"flag", by decide, j, rfl⟩
626 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw
627 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw
628 · exact ⟨"out", by decide, j, rfl⟩
629
630/-- The writes of the witness, by position and location. -/
631theorem wwrite_loc {w : EId} {ev : Event} (hev : (witness mem sh fl).ev? w = some ev) (hw : ev.isWrite = true)
632 {L : Loc} (hL : ev.loc? = some L) :
633 ∃ i : Nat, i < 32 ∧ ((w = (T i, 1) ∧ L = gl "data" i) ∨ (w = (T i, 2) ∧ L = gl "flag" i) ∨
634 (w = (T (32 + i), 2) ∧ L = gl "out" i)) := by
635 rcases w with ⟨w1, w2⟩
636 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩⟩ :=
637 wev mem sh fl hev
638 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw
639 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩⟩
640 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩)⟩
641 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw
642 · simp [Event.isWrite] at hw
643 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩)⟩
644
645/-- The witness's reads-from edges. -/
646theorem wrf_cases {r w : EId} (h : (witness mem sh fl).rf r = some w) :
647 ∃ i, i < 32 ∧ ((r = (T (32 + i), 0) ∧ w = (T i, 2)) ∨ (r = (T (32 + i), 1) ∧ w = (T i, 1))) := by
648 change wrf r = some w at h
649 unfold wrf at h
650 rcases r with ⟨⟨b, t⟩, j⟩
651 dsimp only at h
652 by_cases h1 : b = 0 ∧ 32 ≤ t ∧ t < 64
653 · rw [if_pos h1] at h
654 obtain ⟨rfl, h32, h64⟩ := h1
655 by_cases h2 : j = 0
656 · rw [if_pos h2] at h
657 subst h2
658 refine ⟨t - 32, by omega, Or.inl ⟨?_, (Option.some.inj h).symm⟩⟩
659 show ((⟨0, t⟩ : Tid), 0) = (⟨0, 32 + (t - 32)⟩, 0)
660 congr 2; omega
661 · rw [if_neg h2] at h
662 by_cases h3 : j = 1
663 · rw [if_pos h3] at h
664 subst h3
665 refine ⟨t - 32, by omega, Or.inr ⟨?_, (Option.some.inj h).symm⟩⟩
666 show ((⟨0, t⟩ : Tid), 1) = (⟨0, 32 + (t - 32)⟩, 1)
667 congr 2; omega
668 · rw [if_neg h3] at h; cases h
669 · rw [if_neg h1] at h; cases h
670
671theorem wrf_c0 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).rf (T (32 + i), 0) = some (T i, 2) := by
672 show wrf _ = _
673 have h1 : 32 ≤ 32 + i := by omega
674 have h2 : 32 + i < 64 := by omega
675 simp [wrf, h1, h2]
676theorem wrf_c1 {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).rf (T (32 + i), 1) = some (T i, 1) := by
677 show wrf _ = _
678 have h1 : 32 ≤ 32 + i := by omega
679 have h2 : 32 + i < 64 := by omega
680 simp [wrf, h1, h2]
681
682/-- The release store of lane `i` synchronizes with its acquire load. -/
683theorem wsw {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).causeBase (T i, 2) (T (32 + i), 0) :=
684 (witness mem sh fl).causeBase_of_release_acquire (by simp [T]) (wvalid_p mem sh fl hi (by omega))
685 (wvalid_c mem sh fl hi (by omega)) rfl (wev_p2 mem sh fl hi) (wev_c0 mem sh fl hi) (wrf_c0 mem sh fl hi)
686
687/-- The store of `data` of lane `i` is causally before its load. -/
688theorem wcb_data {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) : (witness mem sh fl).causeBase (T i, 1) (T (32 + i), 1) :=
689 TC.step (Or.inl ((witness mem sh fl).po_of_lt (i := 1) (j := 2) (by omega) (wvalid_p mem sh fl hi (by omega))))
690 (Exec.TC_trans (wsw mem sh fl hi)
691 (TC.base (Or.inl ((witness mem sh fl).po_of_lt (i := 0) (j := 1) (by omega) (wvalid_c mem sh fl hi (by omega))))))
692
693/-- Dependencies point backwards. -/
694theorem wdeps {x : EId} (hv : (witness mem sh fl).valid x) : ∀ d ∈ (witness mem sh fl).deps x, d < x.2 := by
695 obtain ⟨hb, ht, hj⟩ := (wvalid mem sh fl).1 hv
696 rcases x with ⟨⟨b, t⟩, j⟩
697 dsimp only at hb ht hj ⊢
698 subst hb
699 intro d hd
700 change d ∈ (((wtr mem ⟨0, t⟩)[j]?).map Ev.deps).getD [] at hd
701 unfold wtr at hd
702 dsimp only at hd
703 by_cases h1 : t < 32
704 · rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, h1⟩] at hd
705 rcases j with _ | _ | _ | j
706 · simp at hd
707 · simp at hd; omega
708 · simp at hd
709 · omega
710 · rw [if_neg (fun h => h1 h.2), if_pos ⟨rfl, ht⟩] at hd
711 rcases j with _ | _ | _ | j
712 · simp at hd
713 · simp at hd; omega
714 · simp at hd; omega
715 · omega
716
717/-- The witness has a rank, and so is consistent. -/
718theorem wranked : (witness mem sh fl).Ranked wrank where
719 po := fun x y h => by obtain ⟨hth, hlt, -⟩ := h; unfold wrank; rw [hth]; omega
720 rfe := fun x y h => by
721 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ := wrf_cases mem sh fl h <;>
722 (have h' : ¬ (32 + i < 32) := by omega
723 simp [wrank, hi, h'])
724 deps := fun x y hth hd hv => by
725 have := wdeps mem sh fl hv x.2 hd
726 unfold wrank; rw [hth]; omega
727 noBar := wnot_has mem sh fl fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
728 noArrive := wnot_has mem sh fl fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
729 noFence := wnot_has mem sh fl fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
730 noRMW := wnot_has mem sh fl fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
731 noShfl := wnot_has mem sh fl fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
732 sc := fun _ _ h => h
733 co := fun _ _ h => h
734 rf_none := fun r w hrf hr hw hloc => by
735 obtain ⟨L, hLr, hLw⟩ := hloc
736 obtain ⟨evr, hevr⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 (whas_valid mem sh fl hr).2.2
737 obtain ⟨evw, hevw⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 (whas_valid mem sh fl hw).2.2
738 rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? hevr] at hr
739 rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? hevw] at hw
740 rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq hevr] at hLr
741 rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq hevw] at hLw
742 -- a read of the initial value is a load of `src`: the other reads have a source
743 have hsrc : ∃ i : Int, evr = ldSrc i (mem "src" i) := by
744 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨hr1, ⟨hr2, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨hr1, ⟨hr2, rfl⟩ | ⟨hr2, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩⟩⟩ :=
745 wev mem sh fl hevr
746 · exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
747 · simp [Event.isRead] at hr
748 · simp [Event.isRead] at hr
749 · have hr' : r = (T (32 + i), 0) := Prod.ext hr1 hr2
750 rw [hr', wrf_c0 mem sh fl hi] at hrf; cases hrf
751 · have hr' : r = (T (32 + i), 1) := Prod.ext hr1 hr2
752 rw [hr', wrf_c1 mem sh fl hi] at hrf; cases hrf
753 · simp [Event.isRead] at hr
754 obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hsrc
755 -- and nothing writes `src`
756 obtain ⟨a, ha, j, hj⟩ := wwrite_arr mem sh fl hevw hw
757 rw [hj] at hLw
758 simp only [Event.loc?, Option.some.injEq] at hLr hLw
759 rw [← hLr] at hLw
760 exact ha (gl_inj hLw).1
761 write_unique := fun w w' hw hw' hloc => by
762 obtain ⟨L, hLw, hLw'⟩ := hloc
763 obtain ⟨evw, hevw⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 (whas_valid mem sh fl hw).2.2
764 obtain ⟨evw', hevw'⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 (whas_valid mem sh fl hw').2.2
765 rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? hevw] at hw
766 rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? hevw'] at hw'
767 rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq hevw] at hLw
768 rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq hevw'] at hLw'
769 obtain ⟨i, hi, hc⟩ := wwrite_loc mem sh fl hevw hw hLw
770 obtain ⟨j, hj, hc'⟩ := wwrite_loc mem sh fl hevw' hw' hLw'
771 rcases hc with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;> rcases hc' with ⟨rfl, hL⟩ | ⟨rfl, hL⟩ | ⟨rfl, hL⟩ <;>
772 first
773 | exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
774 | (have hij : i = j := by have := (gl_inj hL).2; omega
775 subst hij; rfl)
776
777/-- The remaining well-formedness clauses: traces, dependencies, reads and their values. -/
778theorem wwf : (witness mem sh fl).WF := by
779 refine (wranked mem sh fl).wf ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
780 · intro t ht
781 apply wtr_launch
782 intro h
783 rcases ht with ht | ht
784 · exact absurd (show 1 ≤ t.blk from ht) (by omega)
785 · exact absurd (show 64 ≤ t.thr from ht) (by omega)
786 · intro x hx
787 obtain ⟨ev, hev⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 hx.2.2
788 rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? hev]
789 obtain ⟨i, h⟩ := wshape mem sh fl hev
790 rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rfl
791 · exact fun x hx => wdeps mem sh fl hx
792 · intro r w hrf
793 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ := wrf_cases mem sh fl hrf
794 · refine ⟨?_, wvalid_c mem sh fl hi (by omega), wvalid_p mem sh fl hi (by omega), ?_, ⟨gl "flag" i, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
795 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? (wev_c0 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
796 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? (wev_p2 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
797 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq (wev_c0 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
798 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq (wev_p2 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
799 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).readVal?_eq (wev_c0 mem sh fl hi), (witness mem sh fl).writeVal?_eq (wev_p2 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
800 · refine ⟨?_, wvalid_c mem sh fl hi (by omega), wvalid_p mem sh fl hi (by omega), ?_, ⟨gl "data" i, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
801 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? (wev_c1 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
802 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? (wev_p1 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
803 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq (wev_c1 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
804 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq (wev_p1 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
805 · rw [(witness mem sh fl).readVal?_eq (wev_c1 mem sh fl hi), (witness mem sh fl).writeVal?_eq (wev_p1 mem sh fl hi)]; rfl
806 · intro r hv hr hrf L hL
807 obtain ⟨ev, hev⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 hv.2.2
808 rw [(witness mem sh fl).has_of_ev? hev] at hr
809 rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq hev] at hL
810 rw [(witness mem sh fl).readVal?_eq hev]
811 rcases r with ⟨r1, r2⟩
812 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩⟩ := wev mem sh fl hev
813 · simp [Event.loc?] at hL
814 subst hL
815 exact ⟨fun n hn => by simp [Event.readVal?] at hn; rw [← hn]; rfl, fun f hf => by simp [Event.readVal?] at hf⟩
816 · simp [Event.isRead] at hr
817 · simp [Event.isRead] at hr
818 · rw [wrf_c0 mem sh fl hi] at hrf; cases hrf
819 · rw [wrf_c1 mem sh fl hi] at hrf; cases hrf
820 · simp [Event.isRead] at hr
821
822/-- Every memory event of the witness, by position and location. -/
823theorem wloc {x : EId} {ev : Event} (hev : (witness mem sh fl).ev? x = some ev) {L : Loc} (hL : ev.loc? = some L) :
824 ∃ i : Nat, i < 32 ∧ ((x = (T i, 0) ∧ L = gl "src" i) ∨ (x = (T i, 1) ∧ L = gl "data" i) ∨
825 (x = (T i, 2) ∧ L = gl "flag" i) ∨ (x = (T (32 + i), 0) ∧ L = gl "flag" i) ∨
826 (x = (T (32 + i), 1) ∧ L = gl "data" i) ∨ (x = (T (32 + i), 2) ∧ L = gl "out" i)) := by
827 rcases x with ⟨x1, x2⟩
828 obtain ⟨i, hi, ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩⟩ :=
829 wev mem sh fl hev
830 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩⟩
831 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩)⟩
832 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩))⟩
833 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩)))⟩
834 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩))))⟩
835 · exact ⟨i, hi, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj hL).symm⟩))))⟩
836
837/-- The witness is race free: the only conflicts are each lane's store and load of `data`,
838which the flag orders, and its store and load of the flag, which synchronize. -/
839theorem wraceFree : (witness mem sh fl).RaceFree := by
840 intro x y hc
841 obtain ⟨hvx, hvy, hne, ⟨L, hLx, hLy⟩, -⟩ := hc
842 obtain ⟨evx, hevx⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 hvx.2.2
843 obtain ⟨evy, hevy⟩ := (witness mem sh fl).ev?_some_iff.2 hvy.2.2
844 rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq hevx] at hLx
845 rw [(witness mem sh fl).loc?_eq hevy] at hLy
846 obtain ⟨i, hi, hx⟩ := wloc mem sh fl hevx hLx
847 obtain ⟨j, hj, hy⟩ := wloc mem sh fl hevy hLy
848 rcases hx with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
849 rcases hy with ⟨rfl, hL⟩ | ⟨rfl, hL⟩ | ⟨rfl, hL⟩ | ⟨rfl, hL⟩ | ⟨rfl, hL⟩ | ⟨rfl, hL⟩ <;>
850 first
851 | exact absurd (gl_inj hL).1 (by decide)
852 | (have hij : i = j := by have := (gl_inj hL).2; omega
853 subst hij
854 first
855 | exact absurd rfl hne
856 | exact Or.inl (wcb_data mem sh fl hi)
857 | exact Or.inr (Or.inl (wcb_data mem sh fl hi))
858 | exact Or.inl (wsw mem sh fl hi)
859 | exact Or.inr (Or.inl (wsw mem sh fl hi)))
860
861theorem int32_one : int32 1 := ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
862
863variable {args : Env} {fargs : FEnv}
864
865/-- The run of a lane of the first warp. -/
866theorem wrun_prod {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) (h32 : int32 (mem "src" i)) :
867 ∃ ts, Run (launchIds 1 64 0 i) (T i) publish publish.body (TS.init args fargs) (wtr mem (T i)) ts := by
868 refine ⟨_, Run.of_eq (Run.seq (Run.assign (EvalE.bin EvalE.threadIdx rfl EvalE.lit (by simp)))
869 (Run.iteT (EvalE.bin EvalE.threadIdx rfl EvalE.lit (by simp)) (lt_val hi)
870 (Run.seq (Run.store EvalE.var (EvalE.load (v := mem "src" i) EvalE.var h32))
871 (Run.seq (Run.assign EvalE.var) (Run.astore EvalE.var EvalE.lit))))) ?_⟩
872 simp [wtr, hi, TS.emit, TS.init, locOf_eq, lane_lt hi, StoreOrder.ptx, ThreadScope.ptx, launchIds, Dim3.get]
873
874/-- The run of a lane of the second warp, whose first look at the flag finds it set. -/
875theorem wrun_cons {i : Nat} (hi : i < 32) (h32 : int32 (mem "src" i)) :
876 ∃ ts, Run (launchIds 1 64 0 (32 + i)) (T (32 + i)) publish publish.body (TS.init args fargs) (wtr mem (T (32 + i))) ts := by
877 refine ⟨_, Run.of_eq (Run.seq (Run.assign (EvalE.bin EvalE.threadIdx rfl EvalE.lit (by simp)))
878 (Run.iteF (EvalE.of_val (EvalE.bin EvalE.threadIdx rfl EvalE.lit (by simp)) (lt_val_ge (i := 32 + i) (by omega)))
879 (Run.seq (Run.assign EvalE.var)
880 (Run.seq (Run.seq (Run.aload (v := 1) EvalE.var int32_one)
881 (Run.loopExit (EvalE.of_val (EvalE.bin EvalE.var rfl EvalE.lit (by simp)) ?_)))
882 (Run.store EvalE.var (EvalE.load (v := mem "src" i) EvalE.var h32)))))) ?_⟩
883 · simp [BinOp.evalW, BinOp.eval]
884 · have h1 : ¬ (32 + i < 32) := by omega
885 have h2 : 32 + i < 64 := by omega
886 simp [wtr, h1, h2, TS.emit, TS.init, locOf_eq, lane_ge' hi, LoadOrder.ptx, ThreadScope.ptx, launchIds, Dim3.get]
887
888/-- The witness is a candidate execution of the launch. -/
889theorem wcand (hty : Typed args mem sh) :
890 publish.Candidate 1 64 (launchIds 1 64) args mem sh fl (witness mem sh fl) where
891 gd_eq := rfl
892 bd_eq := rfl
893 run := fun t hb ht => by
894 rcases t with ⟨b, i⟩
895 have hb0 : b = 0 := by simp at hb; omega
896 subst hb0
897 by_cases hi : i < 32
898 · exact wrun_prod mem hi (hty.mem _ _)
899 · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : (∃ j, i = 32 + j) := ⟨i - 32, by omega⟩
900 exact wrun_cons mem (by simp at ht; omega) (hty.mem _ _)
901 init := fun l => rfl
902 finit := fun l => rfl
903
904/-- **The existence half.** -/
905theorem exists_exec (hty : Typed args mem sh) :
906 ∃ e, publish.Candidate 1 64 (launchIds 1 64) args mem sh fl e ∧ e.Consistent ∧ e.RaceFree :=
907 ⟨witness mem sh fl, wcand mem sh fl hty, (wranked mem sh fl).consistent (wwf mem sh fl), wraceFree mem sh fl⟩
908
909end Exists
910
911/-! ## The contract -/
912
913theorem publish_contract : publish.contract := by
914 intro gd bd mem sh args fl hty
915 dsimp only
916 intro hpre
917 obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, hflag, -⟩ := hpre
918 have hflag' : ∀ i : Int, 0 ≤ i → i < 32 → mem "flag" i = 0 := hflag
919 refine ⟨?_, exists_exec mem sh fl hty⟩
920 intro m fm hbeh
921 obtain ⟨e, hcand, hc, -, hfin⟩ := hbeh
